en: Good morning! How are you doing today?
zh: 早安！你今天過得好嗎？

en: Good afternoon! How is your day going so far?
zh: 午安！今天到目前為止順利嗎？

en: Good evening! Did you have a good day?
zh: 晚上好！今天過得好嗎？

en: How's everything going with you?
zh: 你一切都還順利嗎？

en: How have you been lately?
zh: 你最近過得怎麼樣？

en: What's up? Anything new?
zh: 嗨！最近有什麼新鮮事嗎？

en: How's life treating you these days?
zh: 最近日子過得還好嗎？

en: Long time no see! What have you been up to?
zh: 好久不見！你最近都在忙什麼？

en: It's been a while, hasn't it?
zh: 好一陣子沒見了，對吧？

en: I haven't seen you in ages!
zh: 我好久沒見到你了！

en: It's so great to see you again.
zh: 能再見到你真是太好了。

en: What's new with you?
zh: 最近有什麼新消息嗎？

en: Not much, just the usual routine.
zh: 沒什麼特別的，就跟平常一樣。

en: Same old, same old.
zh: 老樣子，沒什麼變。

en: Couldn't be better, thanks!
zh: 好得不能再好了，謝謝！

en: I'm doing pretty well, thanks for asking.
zh: 我過得蠻好的，謝謝你的關心。

en: I've been keeping busy with work.
zh: 我最近工作一直蠻忙的。

en: I'm just hanging in there.
zh: 就還過得去／還在撐著。

en: How's your morning going?
zh: 你今天早上過得好嗎？

en: Morning! Did you sleep well last night?
zh: 早安！昨晚睡得好嗎？

en: How was your weekend?
zh: 你週末過得如何？

en: Did you do anything fun over the weekend?
zh: 你週末有去哪裡玩嗎？

en: Are you having a good day today?
zh: 你今天過得開心嗎？

en: I hope you're having a wonderful day.
zh: 希望你今天過得很順心。

en: Have a great day ahead!
zh: 祝你有個美好順利的一天！

en: Enjoy the rest of your day!
zh: 好好享受今天剩下的時間！

en: Have a good one!
zh: 祝你今天愉快！

en: Have a fantastic weekend!
zh: 祝你有個超棒的週末！

en: I've got to get going now.
zh: 我現在得動身先走了。

en: I need to head out soon.
zh: 我等等得準備出發了。

en: I should probably head home now.
zh: 我想我該回家了。

en: I have to run, or I'll be late.
zh: 我得趕緊走了，不然要遲到了。

en: I must be off now. See you later!
zh: 我該先告辭了，晚點見！

en: Catch you later!
zh: 晚點再聊！／回頭見！

en: Talk to you soon!
zh: 下次再聊囉！

en: I'll see you tomorrow morning.
zh: 明天早上見。

en: See you next Monday!
zh: 下週一見！

en: I'll catch up with you later today.
zh: 今天晚點再找你聊。

en: It was so nice catching up with you.
zh: 今天跟你敘舊真的很開心。

en: I'm really glad we bumped into each other.
zh: 真高興今天能遇到你。

en: What a small world to run into you here!
zh: 在這裡巧遇你，世界真小！

en: Let's keep in touch more often.
zh: 我們以後多保持聯絡喔。

en: Take care of yourself!
zh: 好好照顧自己，保重喔！

en: Stay safe and healthy!
zh: 注意安全，保持健康！

en: Have a safe trip home!
zh: 回家路上小心喔！

en: Get home safe!
zh: 平安到家喔！

en: Let me know when you get home safely.
zh: 安全到家後傳個訊息跟我說一聲。

en: Text me when you get there.
zh: 你到了之後傳訊息給我。

en: Say hi to your family for me.
zh: 替我向你的家人問好。

en: Give my best to everyone at home.
zh: 替我向家裡的大家問好。

en: Drop by anytime you're around here.
zh: 只要你來這附近，隨時過來坐坐。

en: I hope to see you again real soon.
zh: 希望很快能再見到你。

en: Enjoy your vacation!
zh: 祝你假期玩得開心！

en: Have a safe flight!
zh: 祝你飛行旅途平安！

en: Welcome back! How was your trip?
zh: 歡迎回來！這趟旅行好玩嗎？

en: Good luck with your interview today!
zh: 祝你今天的面試一切順利！

en: Fingers crossed for your test!
zh: 為你的考試祈求好運！加油！

en: I'll see you at the party tonight.
zh: 我們今晚派對上見。

en: Let's grab lunch sometime next week.
zh: 下週找時間一起吃個午餐吧。

en: I'll text you the details later.
zh: 我晚點把細節傳訊息給你。

en: Take your time and get some rest.
zh: 別著急，好好休息一下。

en: Good night! Sleep tight and sweet dreams.
zh: 晚安！睡個好覺，祝好夢。

en: How are you feeling this morning?
zh: 你今天早上感覺好點了嗎？

en: Are you ready for the day?
zh: 準備好迎接今天了嗎？

en: I'm heading out to grab some coffee. Want anything?
zh: 我要去買杯咖啡，你有要帶什麼嗎？

en: Sorry, I have to take this call real quick.
zh: 抱歉，我需要緊急接一下這通電話。

en: I'm on my way out the door now.
zh: 我現在正準備出門了。

en: Thanks for coming all the way over.
zh: 謝謝你特地大老遠跑一趟過來。

en: Happy birthday! I hope you have a great one.
zh: 生日快樂！希望你今天玩得開心。

en: Congratulations on your new job!
zh: 恭喜你找到新工作！

en: I'm so happy for you!
zh: 我真替你感到高興！

en: I'll see you right after work.
zh: 下班後我們立刻碰面。

en: Let's meet up again before the weekend.
zh: 週末前我們再約出來聚聚吧。

en: Have fun tonight!
zh: 今晚好好玩，盡情享受！

en: Stay warm! It's really chilly outside.
zh: 穿暖和點！外面真的蠻冷的。

en: Stay cool in this heat!
zh: 天氣這麼熱，注意防暑降溫！

en: I'm leaving now. Have a good night!
zh: 我要先離開了，祝你有個愉快的夜晚！

en: I'll talk to you first thing tomorrow.
zh: 明天一早我第一件事就聯絡你。

en: Keep me posted, okay?
zh: 有任何最新消息隨時跟我說喔！

en: Don't be a stranger!
zh: 常保持聯絡，別搞失蹤喔！

en: Hey there, how's your week going?
zh: 嗨，你這週過得還順利嗎？

en: Just checking in to see how you are.
zh: 只是想打個招呼，關心一下你最近如何。

en: Hope you're having a relaxing Sunday.
zh: 希望你有個輕鬆愜意的週日。

en: Glad I caught you before you left.
zh: 真高興在你離開前剛好遇到你。

en: Are you heading out already?
zh: 你這就要走了嗎？

en: Time really flies when we're chatting.
zh: 我們聊著聊著，時間過得真快。

en: I'll let you get back to what you were doing.
zh: 我就不打擾你了，你繼續忙吧。

en: Thanks for the chat, it was really nice.
zh: 謝謝陪我聊天，真的很開心。

en: See you in a couple of days.
zh: 過兩天見囉。

en: Take it easy and enjoy your evening.
zh: 放輕鬆，好好享受今晚的時光。

en: Hope to bump into you again soon.
zh: 希望很快能再巧遇你。

en: I'm about to sign off for the night.
zh: 我差不多要離線去睡覺了。

en: Let's catch up properly over the weekend.
zh: 週末我們找時間好好坐下來聊聊。

en: Have a safe drive home in this rain.
zh: 下雨天開車回家路上小心點。

en: Wishing you the best with your presentation.
zh: 祝你今天的簡報順利成功。

en: Hope you have a quick recovery!
zh: 祝你早日康復！

en: Catch you on the flip side!
zh: 回頭再見囉！

en: I'm off! See you guys tomorrow.
zh: 我閃人囉！大家明天見。

en: Thanks for dropping by!
zh: 謝謝你特地過來坐坐！

en: Take care and talk soon!
zh: 多保重，很快再聊！

en: Hi! I'm Alex. Nice to meet you!
zh: 嗨！我是 Alex，很高興認識你！

en: Nice to meet you too! Where are you from?
zh: 也很高興認識你！你是哪裡人呢？

en: I grew up in Taipei, but I live here now.
zh: 我在台北長大，但現在住在這邊。

en: How long have you lived around here?
zh: 你在這附近住多久了呀？

en: What do you usually do in your free time?
zh: 你休閒時通常都喜歡做些什麼？

en: I love watching movies and trying new food.
zh: 我喜歡看電影和到處吃美食。

en: Have you seen any good movies lately?
zh: 你最近有看過什麼好看的電影嗎？

en: I just finished watching a great series on Netflix.
zh: 我剛在 Netflix 上追完一部超好看的影集。

en: What kind of music are you into?
zh: 你平時都聽哪種類型的音樂？

en: I listen to a lot of pop and indie music.
zh: 我蠻常聽流行音樂和獨立樂團的。

en: Have you been to that new cafe down the street?
zh: 你有去過街角新開的那家咖啡廳嗎？

en: Not yet! Is the coffee there any good?
zh: 還沒耶！那裡的咖啡好喝嗎？

en: Yeah, their iced latte is amazing!
zh: 超好喝的，他們的冰拿鐵很讚！

en: We should definitely check it out together.
zh: 我們改天一定要一起去朝聖看看。

en: Are you free this Saturday afternoon?
zh: 你這週六下午有空嗎？

en: What are your plans for the upcoming holiday?
zh: 接下來的連假你有什麼安排嗎？

en: I'm just planning to relax at home and sleep in.
zh: 我只打算待在家好好放鬆、睡到自然醒。

en: Are you doing anything special for your birthday?
zh: 你生日有打算做什麼特別的慶祝嗎？

en: The weather is so nice and sunny today!
zh: 今天天氣真好，陽光好舒服！

en: I know, right? Perfect day for a walk.
zh: 對啊！超適合出門散步的。

en: It's supposed to rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
zh: 聽說明天會下雨，記得帶把傘。

en: I can't stand this hot and humid weather.
zh: 我真受不了這種又悶又熱的天氣。

en: Are you a morning person or a night owl?
zh: 你是早起型的人還是夜貓子呀？

en: I'm definitely a night owl. I can't wake up early.
zh: 我絕對是夜貓子，早上完全起不來。

en: Do you have any pets at home?
zh: 你有養任何寵物嗎？

en: Yes! I have a golden retriever and a cat.
zh: 有啊！我養了一隻黃金獵犬和一隻貓。

en: That's so adorable! How old are they?
zh: 太可愛了吧！牠們幾歲了？

en: Do you like to cook, or do you prefer eating out?
zh: 你喜歡自己煮飯，還是比較喜歡外食？

en: I usually cook on weekdays to save some money.
zh: 我平日通常自己煮，比較省錢。

en: What's your absolute favorite food?
zh: 你最愛吃的食物是什麼？

en: I could eat pizza and pasta every single day.
zh: 我每天吃披薩和義大利麵都吃不膩。

en: Have you ever traveled abroad alone?
zh: 你曾經一個人出國自助旅行過嗎？

en: Yeah, I went to Japan by myself last year.
zh: 有啊，我去年自己一個人去日本玩。

en: That sounds like such a great adventure!
zh: 聽起來是一趟很棒的冒險體驗！

en: Where do you want to travel next?
zh: 你下次最想去哪裡旅遊？

en: I've always wanted to visit Europe.
zh: 我一直很想去歐洲走走。

en: How is work going for you these days?
zh: 你最近工作上一切都還順利嗎？

en: It's been pretty busy, but I'm managing.
zh: 蠻忙碌的，但還應付得過來。

en: Do you like your current job?
zh: 你喜歡你現在這份工作嗎？

en: My team is great, so that makes a big difference.
zh: 我的團隊同事很棒，這差很多。

en: I really need a vacation right now.
zh: 我現在真的很需要放個大假。

en: Tell me about it! I feel the exact same way.
zh: 完全同意！我也有同感。

en: How do you usually commute to work?
zh: 你平時都怎麼通勤上班？

en: I just take the subway; it's fast and easy.
zh: 我都搭捷運／地鐵，又快又方便。

en: Do you play any sports or work out regularly?
zh: 你有在做什麼運動或定期去健身房嗎？

en: I try to go to the gym three times a week.
zh: 我盡量每週去健身房三次。

en: Good for you! I need to start working out too.
zh: 真厲害！我也得開始運動了。

en: What do you like to do on rainy days?
zh: 下雨天你通常喜歡做些什麼？

en: I like staying in bed, reading, and drinking tea.
zh: 我喜歡窩在床上看書、喝杯熱茶。

en: Have you tried that new restaurant near the station?
zh: 你有吃過車站附近那家新開的餐廳嗎？

en: I heard the food is great, but the line is so long.
zh: 我聽說很好吃，但排隊排好長。

en: Yeah, we should book a table in advance.
zh: 對啊，我們應該要先提前訂位。

en: Are you watching the game tonight?
zh: 你今晚會看那場球賽嗎？

en: Of course! My whole family is watching it.
zh: 當然！我們全家都要一起看。

en: Who do you think is going to win?
zh: 你覺得哪一隊會贏？

en: It's hard to say, both teams are really strong.
zh: 很難說耶，兩隊實力都很強。

en: Do you follow any podcasts?
zh: 你有在聽什麼 Podcast 節目嗎？

en: I listen to comedy and tech podcasts during my commute.
zh: 我通勤時都聽一些搞笑或科技類的 Podcast。

en: Can you recommend a good place for brunch around here?
zh: 你能推薦這附近哪裡有不錯的早午餐嗎？

en: There's a cozy little spot just two blocks away.
zh: 走兩個街區就有一家很溫馨的小店喔。

en: Let's go there together this weekend.
zh: 那我們這週末一起去吃吧。

en: How did you two first meet?
zh: 你們兩個當初是怎麼認識的啊？

en: We were classmates back in college.
zh: 我們以前大學時是同班同學。

en: No way! That's such a cool coincidence.
zh: 真的假的！也太巧了吧。

en: What are you drinking? Is it good?
zh: 你喝的是什麼呀？好喝嗎？

en: It's a mango smoothie, super refreshing!
zh: 是芒果冰沙，超級消暑清爽！

en: Mind if I sit here with you?
zh: 你介意我坐在這裡跟你一起嗎？

en: Not at all! Please take a seat.
zh: 完全不介意！請坐請坐。

en: So, how was your day today?
zh: 話說回來，你今天過得如何？

en: Pretty good! Just finished my project on time.
zh: 蠻不錯的！剛剛剛好按時把專案做完。

en: That must be such a relief!
zh: 那一定鬆了一大口氣吧！

en: Are you doing anything after this?
zh: 等等結束後你有要去做什麼嗎？

en: I'm meeting up with a friend for dinner.
zh: 我要跟一個朋友約吃晚餐。

en: Sounds fun! Have a great time.
zh: 聽起來真棒！好好享受喔。

en: I love your jacket! Where did you get it?
zh: 我很喜歡你的外套！你在哪裡買的？

en: Thanks! I got it on sale online.
zh: 謝謝！我是在網路上打折時買的。

en: It looks really good on you.
zh: 穿在你身上真的超好看。

en: Have you ever been to New York?
zh: 你曾經去過紐約嗎？

en: Yeah, I went there two years ago for vacation.
zh: 有啊，我兩年前去那裡度假過。

en: What was your favorite part of the city?
zh: 那座城市你最喜歡的部分是什麼？

en: Central Park was definitely my favorite.
zh: 中央公園絕對是我最喜歡的地方。

en: Are you taking any fun classes right now?
zh: 你最近有在修什麼有趣的課程嗎？

en: I just started learning conversational Spanish.
zh: 我最近剛開始學西語日常會話。

en: That's awesome! Is it hard to learn?
zh: 太酷了！學起來會很難嗎？

en: A bit, but it's really fun so far.
zh: 有一點，但目前為止覺得很有趣。

en: How do you drink your coffee?
zh: 你的咖啡都喝什麼口味的？

en: Just black coffee with no sugar.
zh: 黑咖啡不加糖。

en: I can't drink coffee without milk and sugar.
zh: 我沒辦法喝黑咖啡，一定要加奶加糖。

en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
zh: 你有兄弟姐妹嗎？

en: I have an older brother and a younger sister.
zh: 我有一個哥哥和一個妹妹。

en: Are you close with them?
zh: 你們感情好嗎？

en: Yeah, we hang out all the time.
zh: 很好啊，我們常常一起出來玩。

en: What's the best concert you've ever been to?
zh: 你看過最棒的演唱會是哪一場？

en: Coldplay! The energy was incredible.
zh: Coldplay！現場氣氛真的太狂熱了。

en: I'm so jealous, I wish I could go!
zh: 好羨慕喔，我也好想去！

en: Let's definitely buy tickets together next time.
zh: 下次有機會我們一定要一起買票去。

en: It was really nice talking with you today.
zh: 今天能和你聊天真的很愉快。

en: Same here! We should do this again soon.
zh: 我也是！我們近期一定要再聚聚。

en: Don't forget to send me that link later.
zh: 晚點別忘了把那個連結傳給我喔。

en: Will do! Have a wonderful evening.
zh: 沒問題！祝你有個愉快的夜晚。

en: Thank you so much for your help!
zh: 非常感謝你的幫忙！

en: Thanks a million! I really appreciate it.
zh: 萬分感謝！我真的很感激。

en: I can't thank you enough.
zh: 我真的不知道該怎麼感謝你才好。

en: Thanks for the heads up!
zh: 謝謝你提前提醒／通報我！

en: Thanks for letting me know.
zh: 謝謝你告訴我這件事。

en: Thank you for having me over.
zh: 謝謝你今天邀請我來做客。

en: Thanks for buying me lunch today!
zh: 謝謝你今天請我吃午餐！

en: You're the best! I owe you one.
zh: 你人太好了！我欠你一次人情。

en: I truly appreciate your time and patience.
zh: 我真心感謝你的時間與耐心。

en: Thanks for taking care of that for me.
zh: 謝謝你幫我處理好那件事。

en: You're very welcome!
zh: 不客氣！

en: No problem at all!
zh: 完全沒問題／小事一樁！

en: Don't mention it.
zh: 別客氣／不用掛在心上。

en: Anytime! Glad I could help.
zh: 隨時樂意幫忙！很高興能幫上忙。

en: It's no big deal, really.
zh: 真的沒什麼大不了的啦。

en: My pleasure!
zh: 這是我的榮幸／我很樂意。

en: I'm so sorry, my bad!
zh: 真不好意思，是我的錯！

en: Sorry about that! I didn't mean to.
zh: 不好意思！我不是故意的。

en: I'm really sorry to keep you waiting.
zh: 真的很抱歉讓你久等了。

en: Sorry for being late, traffic was terrible.
zh: 抱歉遲到了，路上塞車塞得很嚴重。

en: I apologize for the misunderstanding.
zh: 對於造成的誤會，我深表歉意。

en: I'm sorry, I totally forgot about it.
zh: 抱歉，我完全把這件事給忘了。

en: Sorry to bother you, but do you have a second?
zh: 不好意思打擾你一下，你有空檔嗎？

en: I didn't mean to cut you off. Go ahead.
zh: 我不是故意打斷你的，你請繼續說。

en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
zh: 不好意思，請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

en: Excuse me, could you please tell me the time?
zh: 不好意思，能請教一下現在幾點了嗎？

en: Pardon me, I didn't catch that last part.
zh: 不好意思，我剛剛最後那句沒聽清楚。

en: Could you please repeat that one more time?
zh: 可以麻煩你再重複說一次嗎？

en: Could you speak a little slower, please?
zh: 可以請您說得稍微慢一點點嗎？

en: Would you mind opening the window?
zh: 你介意開一下窗戶嗎？

en: Would you mind if I turned down the music?
zh: 你介意我把音樂音量調小一點嗎？

en: Could you do me a quick favor?
zh: 能請你幫我一個小忙嗎？

en: Could you give me a hand with this box?
zh: 可以幫我一起搬這個箱子嗎？

en: Could you pass me the salt, please?
zh: 可以麻煩把鹽巴遞給我嗎？

en: Can I borrow your pen for a second?
zh: 我可以借用一下你的筆嗎？

en: Here you go!
zh: 拿去吧！／給您！

en: After you, please.
zh: 您先請。

en: Go right ahead!
zh: 請便／你請說／你先請！

en: Please make yourself at home.
zh: 請把這裡當自己家，別客氣。

en: Help yourself to some snacks and drinks.
zh: 點心和飲料請自便，儘管享用。

en: I'm really grateful for your kind advice.
zh: 我非常感激你提供的寶貴建議。

en: Thank you for understanding my situation.
zh: 謝謝你能體諒我的處境。

en: Sorry for the late reply, I was tied up all day.
zh: 抱歉這麼晚才回覆，我今天一整天都在忙。

en: No worries, take your time!
zh: 沒關係，你慢慢來不用急！

en: That's totally fine, don't worry about it.
zh: 完全沒關係的，別放在心上。

en: It happens to the best of us.
zh: 這種事大家都會遇到／在所難免啦。

en: Forget about it, it's all good!
zh: 沒事沒事，別想太多！

en: I really appreciate you checking in on me.
zh: 真的很感謝你特地來關心我。

en: Thanks for being so flexible with the schedule.
zh: 謝謝你願意在時間安排上這麼配合與彈性。

en: I appreciate your quick response.
zh: 非常感謝你迅速的回信與回覆。

en: Thank you for looking out for me.
zh: 謝謝你一直以來這麼照顧我。

en: I owe you a cup of coffee for this!
zh: 因為這件事，我一定要請你喝杯咖啡！

en: I can't tell you how much this means to me.
zh: 你不知道這對我來說有多重要，太感謝了。

en: Sorry, I didn't see you there!
zh: 抱歉，我剛剛沒注意到你在那裡！

en: I apologize for the delay in sending this file.
zh: 對於延遲寄出這份檔案，我深感抱歉。

en: Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.
zh: 抱歉，我不是故意要嚇到你的。

en: Excuse me, could you step aside a little bit?
zh: 不好意思，可以借過／稍微往旁邊站一點嗎？

en: Excuse me, where is the elevator?
zh: 不好意思，請問電梯在哪裡？

en: Could you hold the door for a second, please?
zh: 可以麻煩幫忙按住電梯門一下嗎？

en: Thank you, that was very kind of you.
zh: 謝謝你，你人真好。

en: I really appreciate your hospitality.
zh: 非常感謝您的熱情款待。

en: Thanks for inviting me, I had a blast!
zh: 謝謝你的邀請，我今天玩得超開心的！

en: Thank you for keeping this confidential.
zh: 謝謝你幫我對這件事保守秘密。

en: Sorry, I couldn't hear what you just said.
zh: 抱歉，我剛剛沒聽清楚你說的話。

en: I'm sorry to interrupt your conversation.
zh: 不好意思打擾你們聊天了。

en: Please forgive me for arriving so late.
zh: 請原諒我這麼晚才趕到。

en: It won't happen again, I promise.
zh: 我保證下次絕不會再發生了。

en: Could you possibly help me check this line?
zh: 能麻煩你幫我看一下這一行嗎？

en: Would it be okay if I left a bit early today?
zh: 請問我今天可以稍微早一點點離開嗎？

en: Is it alright if I use your phone charger?
zh: 我可以借用一下你的手機充電器嗎？

en: Sure, go ahead! It's plugged in over there.
zh: 當然可以，拿去用吧！插在那個角落。

en: Thank you for walking me to my car.
zh: 謝謝你陪我走去牽車。

en: Thanks for picking me up at the station.
zh: 謝謝你特地開車來車站接我。

en: I'm sorry for causing you so much trouble.
zh: 很抱歉給你添了這麼多麻煩。

en: It's no trouble at all, happy to help!
zh: 完全不會麻煩，很高興能幫上忙！

en: Thanks for listening to me vent.
zh: 謝謝你願意聽我吐苦水、發牢騷。

en: Anytime, that's what friends are for!
zh: 隨時都行，朋友本來就是用來互相支持的！

en: Thank you for stepping in when I needed help.
zh: 謝謝你在我最需要的時候挺身相助。

en: I really appreciate your thoughtful gesture.
zh: 我真的很感動你的貼心舉動。

en: Sorry, I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
zh: 對不起，我不是故意要傷害你的感受。

en: I accept your apology, let's move on.
zh: 我接受你的道歉，我們翻篇吧。

en: No hard feelings at all!
zh: 完全沒有芥蒂／我一點都沒生氣！

en: Could you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
zh: 可以幫我顧一下包包一分鐘嗎？

en: Sure thing, I'll watch it for you.
zh: 沒問題，我會幫你看著。

en: Thanks for holding my place in line.
zh: 謝謝你幫我排隊佔位子。

en: Sorry for calling so late at night.
zh: 抱歉這麼晚了還打電話給你。

en: Don't worry, I was still wide awake.
zh: 別擔心，我本來就還醒著。

en: Could you please lower your voice slightly?
zh: 可以請您稍微放低一下說話音量嗎？

en: Of course, sorry about that!
zh: 當然可以，真是不好意思！

en: Thanks for the sweet compliment!
zh: 謝謝你的誇獎，聽了真開心！

en: Thank you for being so patient with me.
zh: 謝謝你對我這麼有耐心。

en: I couldn't have done it without your guidance.
zh: 要是沒有你的指點，我一個人肯定搞不定。

en: Thanks for the ride, I really appreciate it.
zh: 謝謝你順路載我一程，太感謝了。

en: Drop me off right here, thank you!
zh: 讓我在這裡下車就可以了，謝謝！

en: Sorry to keep you waiting on the line.
zh: 抱歉讓您在電話線上久等了。

en: Thanks for bearing with me today.
zh: 感謝你今天對我的包容與體諒。

en: Thank you for taking the time to meet with me.
zh: 非常感謝你抽空與我見面。

en: I'm so sorry for mixing up the dates.
zh: 真抱歉，我把日期給搞混了。

en: All is forgiven, don't worry about it.
zh: 沒事啦，完全原諒你，別擔心！

en: Thanks again for everything today!
zh: 今天的一切再次向你道謝！

en: I'm so happy and excited right now!
zh: 我現在超開心、超級興奮的！

en: I feel completely exhausted after work today.
zh: 今天下班後我覺得整個人快累癱了。

en: I'm running on four hours of sleep.
zh: 我昨晚只睡了四個小時，快撐不住了。

en: I'm so burned out from this busy week.
zh: 這忙碌的一週真的讓我身心俱疲。

en: I have so much on my plate right now.
zh: 我目前手頭上的事情多到快忙不過來。

en: I'm feeling really stressed out lately.
zh: 我最近壓力真的蠻大的。

en: Take a deep breath and take it easy.
zh: 深呼吸一下，放輕鬆慢慢來。

en: I feel so relieved that the exam is over.
zh: 考完試了我整個人如釋重負！

en: I can finally relax this weekend.
zh: 這週末我終於可以好好放鬆了。

en: I'm super thrilled about our road trip!
zh: 我對我們接下來的公路旅行超級期待！

en: I can't wait for Friday night!
zh: 我迫不及待想迎接週五晚上了！

en: I'm feeling a little under the weather today.
zh: 我今天身體有點不太舒服。

en: I think I'm catching a cold.
zh: 我想我可能是要感冒了。

en: I woke up on the wrong side of the bed today.
zh: 我今天起床心情很差／諸事不順。

en: I'm in such a good mood this morning!
zh: 我今天早上心情特別好！

en: That coffee really made my day.
zh: 那杯咖啡真的點亮了我的一整天。

en: Your kind words made my day, thank you!
zh: 你溫暖的話讓我一整天都心情大好，謝謝！

en: I feel so awkward when I forget names.
zh: 當我忘記別人的名字時，真的超尷尬。

en: I was so embarrassed I wanted to hide.
zh: 我當時尷尬到恨不得找個地洞鑽進去。

en: I'm so proud of what you've achieved!
zh: 我真為你取得的成就感到無比驕傲！

en: You did an amazing job today!
zh: 你今天表現得太出色了！

en: I'm getting really nervous about the speech.
zh: 我對等等要上台演講感到越來越緊張了。

en: I always get butterflies in my stomach before tests.
zh: 考試前我心裡總是會七上八下緊張不已。

en: Don't worry, you're going to do great!
zh: 別擔心，你一定會表現得超棒的！

en: I'm so annoyed by that loud noise outside.
zh: 外面的噪音吵得我真的很心煩。

en: It's driving me crazy!
zh: 這簡直快把我逼瘋了！

en: I'm sick and tired of eating takeout every day.
zh: 我受夠了每天都在吃外食便當。

en: I feel so grateful to have you as a friend.
zh: 能有你這樣的朋友，我真的很感恩。

en: I feel a bit lonely living on my own sometimes.
zh: 有時候一個人住難免會覺得有點孤單。

en: I'm bored out of my mind right now.
zh: 我現在無聊到發慌。

en: Let's go out and do something fun!
zh: 我們出門找點好玩的樂子吧！

en: I was totally shocked when I heard the news.
zh: 聽到那個消息時我徹底震驚了。

en: I couldn't believe my own eyes!
zh: 我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛！

en: That was such a pleasant surprise!
zh: 那真是個令人又驚又喜的意外！

en: I felt so bad for breaking your favorite mug.
zh: 摔破你最喜歡的馬克杯，我心裡真的很過意不去。

en: I feel much better after talking to you.
zh: 和你聊過之後，我心情好多了。

en: I'm feeling hopeful about this new project.
zh: 我對這個新專案充滿了希望與期待。

en: I'm really disappointed with the final result.
zh: 我對最後的結果感到蠻失望的。

en: Cheer up! Things will get better soon.
zh: 振作起來！事情很快就會好轉的。

en: Hang in there! You're almost at the finish line.
zh: 再堅持一下！你已經快要到達終點了。

en: I'm so jealous that you get to travel to Hawaii!
zh: 你要去夏威夷玩，我真的超羨慕的！

en: I'm feeling so lazy today, I don't want to move.
zh: 我今天整個人好懶散，一步都不想動。

en: I'm so impatient, I want to know the answer now.
zh: 我性子急，我現在就想知道答案。

en: I feel confident that we can win this game.
zh: 我很有信心我們一定能贏下這場比賽。

en: I feel overwhelmed with all these emails.
zh: 看到這麼多待回的郵件，我感到快被淹沒了。

en: Let's tackle them one step at a time.
zh: 我們一步一步慢慢處理就好。

en: I was terrified when the lights went out.
zh: 剛剛突然停電時，我真的嚇壞了。

en: I'm so touched by your sweet message.
zh: 看到你貼心的訊息，我心裡好感動。

en: I can't stop laughing at this funny video.
zh: 看這個搞笑短片，我笑到完全停不下來。

en: That really cracked me up!
zh: 那真的把我逗樂到不行！

en: I feel so relaxed after taking a warm bath.
zh: 泡完熱水澡後，整個人感覺好放鬆。

en: I'm feeling restless, I need to go for a walk.
zh: 我坐立難安，我需要出去走一走。

en: I'm so confused, I don't get this at all.
zh: 我一頭霧水，我完全搞不懂這是什麼意思。

en: I'm glad that we sorted everything out.
zh: 真高興我們把所有事情都釐清解決了。

en: I feel bad that I couldn't make it to your party.
zh: 我很過意不去沒能趕去參加你的派對。

en: Don't feel bad, we'll hang out next time!
zh: 別放在心上，我們下次再聚就好！

en: I'm deeply impressed by your presentation.
zh: 我對你的簡報表現印象非常深刻。

en: I feel uneasy about going home in the dark alone.
zh: 天這麼黑一個人走回家，我心裡有點毛毛的。

en: I'll walk with you so you feel safe.
zh: 我陪你一起走，這樣比較安全。

en: I'm feeling super motivated to work out today.
zh: 我今天充滿幹勁，超想去運動健身。

en: I'm so upset about losing my wallet.
zh: 弄丟了皮夾，我真的難過又懊惱。

en: Did you check under your car seat?
zh: 你有檢查過車子座位底下嗎？

en: I feel so relieved! It was in my backpack all along.
zh: 我鬆了一大口氣！原來一直都在我後背包裡。

en: I'm so sick of this endless traffic jam.
zh: 我真的受夠了這沒完沒了的塞車。

en: Put on some music to help pass the time.
zh: 放點音樂來打發時間吧。

en: I feel nostalgic whenever I hear this old song.
zh: 每次聽到這首老歌，我都湧上一陣懷舊感傷。

en: I feel like celebrating tonight!
zh: 我今天晚上好想好好慶祝一番！

en: Drinks are on me tonight!
zh: 今晚的飲料和酒錢全算我的！

en: I'm frustrated because my computer keeps crashing.
zh: 我的電腦一直當機，真的快把我氣瘋了。

en: Did you remember to back up your files?
zh: 你有記得把檔案存檔備份嗎？

en: I'm so grateful for all your support.
zh: 非常感激你一路以來給予我的支持。

en: I felt helpless when my car broke down.
zh: 車子拋錨在半路上時，我感到無比無助。

en: I'm so glad someone stopped to help you.
zh: 真好，幸好有好心人停下來幫你。

en: I feel energized after drinking my morning coffee.
zh: 喝完早晨的第一杯咖啡後，我精神百倍。

en: I feel like I'm finally getting the hang of this.
zh: 我感覺我終於掌握到這個訣竅了。

en: See? I told you that you could do it!
zh: 你看吧？我就說你一定可以做到的！

en: I'm so drained, I need to sleep for ten hours.
zh: 我能量快耗盡了，我需要狂睡十個小時。

en: Sleep in tomorrow, you deserve the rest.
zh: 明天睡到自然醒吧，你該好好休息了。

en: I'm so thrilled to be a part of this team.
zh: 能成為這個團隊的一份子，我感到非常榮幸與興奮。

en: I was hesitant at first, but now I love it.
zh: 我一開始有點猶豫，但現在我超愛的。

en: I feel a little homesick these days.
zh: 我最近這陣子有點想家。

en: Give your parents a quick call tonight.
zh: 今晚打通電話回家跟爸媽聊聊天吧。

en: I feel silly for worrying so much about nothing.
zh: 為了根本沒發生的事白擔心一場，我覺得自己好傻。

en: We all do that sometimes, don't worry about it.
zh: 我們有時候也都會這樣啦，別在意。

en: I'm feeling so happy and content right now.
zh: 我現在覺得心滿意足、非常幸福。

en: Enjoy this wonderful moment!
zh: 好好享受這個美好的當下吧！

en: I'm heartbroken that my cat is sick.
zh: 我的貓咪生病了，我真的好心疼難過。

en: I hope she gets better really fast.
zh: 希望牠很快就能好起來。

en: I'm looking forward to a cozy night in.
zh: 我很期待今晚在家度過舒適溫馨的夜晚。

en: Get some popcorn and watch a good movie.
zh: 準備點爆米花，看部好電影吧。

en: I'm so eager to hear all about your trip.
zh: 我超想趕快聽你分享旅行的所有趣事！

en: I have so many funny stories to tell you!
zh: 我有好多好笑的故事要講給你聽！

en: I'm terrified of spiders and bugs.
zh: 我超級害怕蜘蛛和各種蟲子。

en: Don't worry, I'll get rid of it for you.
zh: 別怕，我來幫你把牠弄走。

en: I felt so welcomed by everyone here.
zh: 這裡的每個人都好熱情，讓我感到非常受歡迎。

en: We're all super glad that you're here.
zh: 我們大家都非常高興你的到來。

en: I'm losing my mind trying to fix this bug.
zh: 為了解這個程式錯誤，我快要抓狂了。

en: Step away for ten minutes, it usually helps.
zh: 先離開螢幕走動十分鐘，通常很有幫助。

en: I feel refreshed and ready to go again.
zh: 我現在清醒多了，準備好再次出發！

en: That's the spirit! Keep up the good work.
zh: 這就對了！繼續保持這股衝勁！

en: I totally agree with you on that.
zh: 在那一點上我完全同意你的看法。

en: You can say that again!
zh: 你說得太對了！／完全贊同！

en: I couldn't agree more.
zh: 我完全不能同意你更多了／說得真好。

en: That makes a lot of sense.
zh: 那樣說非常有道理。

en: That's a very good point.
zh: 那是個很棒的觀點。

en: You took the words right out of my mouth!
zh: 你剛好把我心裡想說的話說出來了！

en: I feel the exact same way.
zh: 我的感受和你一模一樣。

en: Exactly! That's what I was thinking.
zh: 沒錯！我剛剛心裡想的正是這樣。

en: I see what you mean, but let's consider the cost.
zh: 我懂你的意思，但我們也得考量成本。

en: I see your point, but I have a different opinion.
zh: 我明白你的看法，但我有不同的觀點。

en: To be honest, I'm not so sure about that.
zh: 老實說，我對那件事並不是很確定。

en: I don't think that's a good idea.
zh: 我覺得那個點子可能不太行。

en: I have mixed feelings about this decision.
zh: 對於這個決定，我內心情緒蠻複雜的。

en: If you ask me, we should do it right away.
zh: 如果你問我的意見，我認為我們該立刻去做。

en: From my experience, this method works best.
zh: 依我的經驗，這個方法效果最顯著。

en: As far as I know, they haven't decided yet.
zh: 據我所知，他們目前還沒有做最後決定。

en: In my opinion, we need more time to prepare.
zh: 依我看，我們需要更多的準備時間。

en: What do you think about this proposal?
zh: 你覺得這份提議方案怎麼樣？

en: How do you feel about moving the meeting to Friday?
zh: 把會議改到週五，你覺得如何？

en: Do you have any thoughts on this topic?
zh: 關於這個話題，你有什麼想法嗎？

en: I think it really depends on the situation.
zh: 我認為這很大程度要視情況而定。

en: That depends on how much budget we have.
zh: 那取決於我們手頭上有多少預算。

en: That sounds like a solid plan to me.
zh: 對我來說，這聽起來是個很可靠的計畫。

en: I'm totally on board with this idea.
zh: 我百分之百贊成並支持這個點子。

en: Count me in! That sounds amazing.
zh: 算我一份！聽起來超棒的。

en: I'd rather wait and see what happens.
zh: 我比較想先靜觀其變，看看後續發展。

en: Let's look at it from another angle.
zh: 我們換個角度來看這件事吧。

en: Fair enough, that sounds reasonable.
zh: 說得也是，那樣聽起來蠻合理的。

en: You have a point there.
zh: 你在這一點上說得確實有理。

en: I doubt that will actually work in practice.
zh: 我很懷疑那樣在實際操作上到底行不行得通。

en: Are you sure about that? Have you checked?
zh: 你確定嗎？你有先核實過嗎？

en: I'm positive! I double checked this morning.
zh: 我非常確定！我今天早上剛仔細核對過。

en: I might be wrong, but that's just my guess.
zh: 我也許說錯，但那只是我個人的猜測。

en: Don't get me wrong, I like the concept.
zh: 別誤會我的意思，我其實蠻喜歡這個概念的。

en: Personally, I prefer the blue one over the red one.
zh: 就個人而言，我比較喜歡藍色的那個而不是紅色的。

en: I think we're on the same page now.
zh: 我想我們現在雙方的共識是一致的了。

en: Let's agree to disagree on this one.
zh: 關於這一點，我們就各自保留意見吧。

en: That's totally beside the point.
zh: 那根本完全離題了／不是重點。

en: Let's get straight to the point.
zh: 我們直接切入核心重點吧。

en: What's the bottom line here?
zh: 這件事最根本的底線／結論是什麼？

en: The bottom line is that we need more sales.
zh: 最根本的結論就是我們需要提高銷售額。

en: I don't think it's worth the risk.
zh: 我認為冒這個風險並不值得。

en: It's definitely worth a shot!
zh: 這絕對值得嘗試一下！

en: What do we have to lose?
zh: 反正我們也沒什麼好失去的，怕什麼？

en: Nothing beats home-cooked meals.
zh: 沒有什麼比家常菜更棒的了。

en: I couldn't have said it better myself.
zh: 說得太好了，換作是我也沒法表達得更精闢。

en: That's easier said than done.
zh: 那真是說得比做得容易。

en: I believe communication is the key to success.
zh: 我相信溝通是成功的關鍵所在。

en: Practice makes perfect, in my view.
zh: 依我看，熟能生巧是不變的道理。

en: I see where you're coming from.
zh: 我能理解你為什麼會這麼想／你的出發點。

en: I don't see any problem with that.
zh: 我看不出那樣做會有什麼問題。

en: Sounds good to me! Let's do it.
zh: 我聽起來覺得很可以！就這麼辦吧。

en: I'm leaning towards the second option.
zh: 我個人目前比較傾向於第二個選項。

en: Which option do you think is better?
zh: 你覺得哪一個選項比較好？

en: The first option is cheaper, but the second is faster.
zh: 第一個選項比較便宜，但第二個比較快。

en: I guess you're right about that.
zh: 我想你在那一點上大概是對的。

en: No doubt about it!
zh: 這毫無疑問！

en: Without a doubt, this is the best cafe in town.
zh: 毫無疑問，這是鎮上最棒的咖啡館。

en: I'm not convinced yet. Show me the data.
zh: 我還沒被說服，拿數據給我看吧。

en: That makes no sense at all.
zh: 那樣講根本完全不合邏輯／說不通。

en: Let's give it some more thought before deciding.
zh: 在做決定之前，我們再多深思一下吧。

en: Sleep on it and decide tomorrow.
zh: 先睡一覺，明天再做決定吧。

en: I changed my mind after reading the review.
zh: 看完那篇評論後，我改變主意了。

en: What made you change your mind?
zh: 是什麼讓你改變了心意？

en: To put it simply, we ran out of time.
zh: 簡單來說，就是我們的時間不夠用了。

en: In other words, we need to redo the whole thing.
zh: 換句話說，我們需要把整件事重做一遍。

en: That's one way to look at it.
zh: 這也是看待這件事的一種角度啦。

en: I wouldn't go that far.
zh: 我倒不至於會說得那麼誇張。

en: That's a bit of an exaggeration, isn't it?
zh: 那樣講稍微有點誇大了吧？

en: Honestly, it doesn't matter to me either way.
zh: 老實說，對我來說哪一種都可以、沒差別。

en: Whatever you decide is fine with me.
zh: 不管你做什麼決定，我都沒意見。

en: I trust your judgment on this.
zh: 在這件事上我相信你的判斷。

en: It's your call, what do you want to do?
zh: 由你決定，你想怎麼做？

en: I leave it entirely up to you.
zh: 這件事我全權交給你決定。

en: That's a tough question to answer.
zh: 這真是個很難回答的問題。

en: There's no right or wrong answer here.
zh: 這件事沒有所謂標準的對與錯。

en: I agree with you up to a point.
zh: 在某種程度上我同意你，但無法全盤接受。

en: I'm totally against that idea.
zh: 我個人完全反對那個提議。

en: Why are you so against it?
zh: 你為什麼會這麼強烈反對呢？

en: Because it's way too expensive for our budget.
zh: 因為那遠遠超出了我們的預算上限。

en: That's true, I hadn't thought of that.
zh: 確實如此，我剛剛還真沒想到這點。

en: Thanks for pointing that out!
zh: 謝謝你指出了這一點！

en: I think you hit the nail on the head.
zh: 我覺得你完全說中要害／一針見血。

en: That's exactly my point.
zh: 這正是我想要表達的重點！

en: I knew you would understand.
zh: 我就知道你一定能懂。

en: Great minds think alike!
zh: 英雄所見略同！

en: I have a feeling this will turn out great.
zh: 我有一種預感，這件事最後一定會很棒。

en: Let's hope for the best!
zh: 讓我們抱持最樂觀的期待吧！

en: Better safe than sorry.
zh: 小心駛得萬年船／謹慎總比後悔好。

en: It's always good to have a backup plan.
zh: 隨時準備個備案總是不會錯的。

en: I think we should stick to the original plan.
zh: 我認為我們應該堅持原本的計畫。

en: If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
zh: 如果運作得好好的，就別去瞎折騰改動它。

en: Times have changed, we need new ideas.
zh: 時代變了，我們需要一些新思維與新點子。

en: I'm open to suggestions if you have any.
zh: 如果你有任何建議，我隨時樂意傾聽。

en: Let's brainstorm some new options together.
zh: 我們一起腦力激盪想些新方案吧。

en: Every little bit helps.
zh: 每一點微小的幫助都很有用。

en: Actions speak louder than words.
zh: 坐而言不如起而行／行動勝於空談。

en: I completely understand where you're coming from.
zh: 我完全能體會並理解你的立場。

en: That sounds like a win-win situation.
zh: 那聽起來是個雙贏的局面。

en: Let's go with that plan then!
zh: 那就照那個方案進行吧！

en: Hi! A table for two, please.
zh: 嗨！兩位，麻煩幫我們安排座位。

en: Do you have a reservation under the name David?
zh: 請問有訂位嗎？登記的名字是 David。

en: We don't have a reservation. Is there a wait?
zh: 我們沒有訂位，請問現在需要候位等多久？

en: How long is the wait for a table of four?
zh: 四個人的位子大概要等多久？

en: Could we get a table by the window?
zh: 我們可以坐靠窗的位子嗎？

en: Can we sit outside on the patio?
zh: 我們可以坐在戶外露天座位區嗎？

en: Could we get the menu, please?
zh: 能麻煩幫我們送上菜單嗎？

en: Do you have an English menu available?
zh: 請問有英文菜單嗎？

en: Can we have a few more minutes to look at the menu?
zh: 可以再給我們幾分鐘看一下菜單嗎？

en: What's the special of the day?
zh: 請問今天的每日主廚特餐是什麼？

en: What do you recommend here?
zh: 你們店裡有什麼推薦的招牌菜嗎？

en: What is your most popular dish?
zh: 你們這裡最受歡迎的人氣餐點是什麼？

en: I'm ready to order now.
zh: 我準備好可以點餐了。

en: I'll have the cheeseburger and fries, please.
zh: 我要一份起司漢堡配薯條，謝謝。

en: I'd like a medium rare steak, please.
zh: 我想要一份五分熟的牛排，謝謝。

en: How would you like your eggs cooked?
zh: 您的蛋想要怎麼料理？（荷包蛋、炒蛋等）

en: Scrambled eggs, please.
zh: 請幫我做炒蛋，謝謝。

en: Can I get an iced Americano with no sugar?
zh: 我可以要一杯無糖冰美式咖啡嗎？

en: I'll have a hot latte with oat milk, please.
zh: 我要一杯熱燕麥奶拿鐵，謝謝。

en: Can you make that decaf, please?
zh: 可以幫我換成低咖啡因的嗎？

en: Is this dish very spicy?
zh: 這道菜會很辣嗎？

en: Can you make it mild / less spicy?
zh: 可以幫我做微辣／少辣一點嗎？

en: Does this pasta contain any dairy or nuts?
zh: 這道義大利麵有含有任何乳製品或堅果嗎？

en: I'm vegetarian. Do you have vegetarian options?
zh: 我是素食者，請問有素食餐點可以選嗎？

en: I'm allergic to seafood, just so you know.
zh: 我對海鮮過敏，先跟您說一聲。

en: Can I get the salad dressing on the side?
zh: 沙拉醬可以幫我另外裝在小碟子裡嗎？

en: Could I get some tap water, please?
zh: 可以給我一杯常溫水／自來開水嗎？

en: Can we have some extra napkins and ice water?
zh: 可以幫我們多拿幾張餐巾紙和冰水嗎？

en: Could you bring us some extra forks and plates?
zh: 能幫我們多拿幾支叉子和小盤子嗎？

en: Excuse me, could we get some ketchup and black pepper?
zh: 不好意思，能給我們一些番茄醬和黑胡椒嗎？

en: For here or to go?
zh: 內用還是外帶？

en: To go, please.
zh: 麻煩外帶，謝謝。

en: For here, please.
zh: 內用，謝謝。

en: Can I get this wrapped up to go?
zh: 可以幫我把這道菜打包外帶嗎？

en: Could I have a to-go box, please?
zh: 可以給我一個外帶打包盒嗎？

en: We'd like to order some dessert now.
zh: 我們現在想加點一些甜點。

en: Do you have cheesecake or chocolate brownies?
zh: 你們有起司蛋糕或巧克力布朗尼嗎？

en: Excuse me, we haven't received our drinks yet.
zh: 不好意思，我們的飲料好像還沒有送來。

en: Could you check on our order, please?
zh: 能麻煩幫我們確認一下餐點進度嗎？

en: Sorry to bother, but I ordered the soup, not the salad.
zh: 不好意思，我點的是湯品而不是沙拉。

en: This isn't what I ordered, could you check?
zh: 這道好像不是我點的，可以幫忙核對一下嗎？

en: Everything tastes absolutely delicious!
zh: 每道菜吃起來都超級美味！

en: This steak is cooked to perfection.
zh: 這塊牛排煎得恰到好處，太完美了。

en: Could we get the check / bill, please?
zh: 買單，麻煩幫我們結帳。

en: Can we pay separately?
zh: 我們可以分開結帳嗎？

en: Let's split the bill evenly.
zh: 我們大家平分這頓餐費吧。

en: Do you accept credit cards or mobile pay?
zh: 請問你們收信用卡或手機行動支付嗎？

en: Is service charge included in the total?
zh: 請問總金額裡面有包含服務費了嗎？

en: Keep the change, thank you!
zh: 不用找零錢了，謝謝！

en: Thank you for the delicious meal!
zh: 謝謝款待，今天這頓餐點非常美味！

en: Can I get a refill on my iced tea?
zh: 我的冰紅茶可以續杯嗎？

en: Are refills free for soft drinks?
zh: 請問汽水飲料是可以免費續杯的嗎？

en: I'll have what she's having.
zh: 我也要一份跟她一樣的餐點。

en: What dressing would you like with your salad?
zh: 您的沙拉想要搭配什麼醬料？

en: Ranch dressing, please.
zh: 請給我田園沙拉醬，謝謝。

en: Can I substitute fries for a side salad?
zh: 我可以把配菜的薯條換成小沙拉嗎？

en: Is the soup of the day mushroom soup?
zh: 今天的今日例湯是蘑菇濃湯嗎？

en: I'd like a glass of house red wine, please.
zh: 我要一杯店裡的精選紅酒，謝謝。

en: Could you bring us some hot water with lemon?
zh: 能幫我們送上一杯熱檸檬水嗎？

en: We're celebrating my friend's birthday today.
zh: 我們今天特地來幫朋友慶生。

en: Do you have any candles for the cake?
zh: 請問你們有可以插在蛋糕上的蠟燭嗎？

en: Could you take a quick photo for us, please?
zh: 能麻煩幫我們大家拍張合照嗎？

en: Just press this big button right here.
zh: 只要按這裡這個大按鈕就可以了。

en: One more, just in case. Smile!
zh: 再拍一張備用，大家笑一個！

en: Thank you so much for taking the photo!
zh: 太感謝你幫我們拍照了！

en: This soup is a little too salty for my taste.
zh: 這碗湯對我個人口味來說稍微有點太鹹。

en: Could you heat this up in the microwave for me?
zh: 可以麻煩幫我用微波爐稍微加熱一下嗎？

en: I'm so full, I can't eat another bite.
zh: 我吃得好飽，真的連一口都吃不下了。

en: There is always room for dessert!
zh: 吃甜點永遠有第二個胃！

en: Let's order one slice of cake and share it.
zh: 我們點一塊蛋糕一起分著吃吧。

en: Do you have any dairy-free ice cream?
zh: 你們有不含乳製品的無奶冰淇淋嗎？

en: What flavors of ice cream do you have?
zh: 你們有哪些口味的冰淇淋？

en: We have vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry.
zh: 我們有香草、巧克力和草莓口味。

en: I'll take one scoop of chocolate in a cone.
zh: 我要一球巧克力甜筒冰淇淋。

en: Can I get a cup of coffee to go?
zh: 我可以帶一杯外帶熱咖啡嗎？

en: Would you like room for milk?
zh: 需要幫您的咖啡預留加牛奶的空間嗎？

en: Yes, just a little bit of room, please.
zh: 好的，請留一點點空間就可以了。

en: How sweet do you want your bubble tea?
zh: 你的珍珠奶茶甜度要幾分甜？

en: Half sugar and less ice, please.
zh: 半糖去冰／微冰，謝謝。

en: Can I add extra boba pearls?
zh: 我可以額外加珍珠嗎？

en: Where can I grab a straw and some napkins?
zh: 吸管和餐巾紙要在哪裡拿？

en: They're right over at the counter on the left.
zh: 就在左手邊的自助調味吧台上。

en: Can we have the food served as it gets ready?
zh: 餐點做好了就麻煩直接陸續幫我們上菜。

en: Is the fish freshly caught today?
zh: 這條魚是今天產地直送的新鮮漁獲嗎？

en: Yes, it's very fresh and tender.
zh: 是的，非常新鮮而且肉質鮮嫩。

en: I'll try that then!
zh: 那我就點這道試試看！

en: Could you bring the kids' meal first, please?
zh: 可以麻煩先送兒童餐上來嗎？

en: Do you provide baby high chairs?
zh: 請問你們店裡有提供兒童專用高腳椅嗎？

en: Yes, I'll bring one right over for you.
zh: 有的，我馬上為您搬一張過來。

en: Could I get a glass of sparkling water with lime?
zh: 可以給我一杯加檸檬片的氣泡水嗎？

en: Is there a minimum charge per person?
zh: 請問店裡有每人低消的限制嗎？

en: Yes, it's one drink or meal per person.
zh: 有的，每人低消是一份餐點或一杯飲品。

en: We're ready for the bill whenever you have time.
zh: 你有空時麻煩幫我們結帳，我們準備好了。

en: Can I pay with contactless on my phone?
zh: 我可以用手機感應付款嗎？

en: Sure, just tap your phone right here.
zh: 當然可以，直接把手機靠在這裡感應即可。

en: Here's your receipt. Have a wonderful night!
zh: 這是您的發票收據，祝您度過愉快的一晚！

en: Thank you, food was great! We'll be back.
zh: 謝謝，餐點超棒的！我們一定會再來。

en: Let's leave a tip for our server.
zh: 我們留點小費給服務生吧。

en: That was hands down the best meal I've had all week.
zh: 這絕對是我這整週吃過最過癮的一餐。

en: I'm definitely recommending this place to my friends.
zh: 我一定要把這家餐廳推薦給我所有的朋友。

en: Excuse me, how much is this shirt?
zh: 不好意思，請問這件襯衫多少錢？

en: Do you have this jacket in a medium size?
zh: 請問這件夾克有 M 號的尺寸嗎？

en: Can I try this on?
zh: 我可以試穿這個嗎？

en: Where are the fitting rooms / dressing rooms?
zh: 請問試衣間在哪裡？

en: They're right around the corner on the left.
zh: 就在左邊轉角處那裡。

en: How does it fit on you?
zh: 穿起來合身嗎？尺寸如何？

en: It's a little too tight around the shoulders.
zh: 肩膀部位稍微有點太緊了。

en: It fits perfectly! I'll take it.
zh: 非常合身！這件我要了。

en: Do you have this in other colors?
zh: 這款還有其他顏色可以選嗎？

en: We have it in black, navy, and beige.
zh: 我們還有黑色、深藍色和米色。

en: Can I see the black one, please?
zh: 可以讓我看一下黑色的那件嗎？

en: Is this item currently on sale?
zh: 這件商品目前有在打折特價嗎？

en: Buy one, get one fifty percent off today.
zh: 今天第二件享半價優惠喔。

en: That's a really great deal!
zh: 那真的非常划算耶！

en: I'm just browsing / looking around, thanks!
zh: 我只是隨便逛逛看看，謝謝！

en: Let me know if you need help finding anything.
zh: 如果您需要找任何商品，隨時跟我說一聲。

en: Where can I find phone chargers and cables?
zh: 請問手機充電器和傳輸線在哪一區？

en: They're in aisle three, next to electronics.
zh: 在第三走道，電子配件區旁邊。

en: Do you have this in stock in the back?
zh: 庫存倉庫裡還有這件的現貨嗎？

en: Let me check the system for you real quick.
zh: 我馬上在電腦系統裡幫您查詢一下。

en: Sorry, it looks like we're all sold out of that size.
zh: 抱歉，看來那個尺寸目前全部售完了。

en: When do you expect the next restock?
zh: 請問預計什麼時候會再補貨呢？

en: It should be back in stock by next Tuesday.
zh: 預計下週二之前會重新進貨。

en: Can you put this on hold for me until tonight?
zh: 可以幫我把這件保留到今天晚上嗎？

en: Sure, what is your name and phone number?
zh: 好的，請問您的大名和聯絡電話是？

en: Are you ready to check out?
zh: 請問準備好結帳了嗎？

en: Yes, just these two items, please.
zh: 是的，就這兩樣東西，麻煩了。

en: Do you accept Apple Pay or credit cards?
zh: 請問收 Apple Pay 或信用卡嗎？

en: We accept all major credit cards and mobile pay.
zh: 我們接受各大信用卡及手機行動支付。

en: Can I pay in cash?
zh: 我可以用現金結帳嗎？

en: Your total comes to forty-five dollars.
zh: 您的結帳總金額是 45 元。

en: Here's fifty dollars.
zh: 這裡給您 50 元。

en: And here is five dollars change and your receipt.
zh: 找您 5 元零錢，這是您的發票收據。

en: Would you like a paper bag or a plastic bag?
zh: 需要紙袋還是塑膠袋嗎？

en: No bag needed, I brought my own tote.
zh: 不需要袋子，我自己有帶環保提袋。

en: Can I get a small shopping bag, please?
zh: 可以給我一個小購物袋嗎？

en: Do you have a membership with us?
zh: 請問有我們的會員嗎？／報電話號碼嗎？

en: Yes, here is my phone number / barcode.
zh: 有的，這是我的會員電話號碼／條碼。

en: Can I redeem my reward points on this purchase?
zh: 我這次消費可以折抵會員積點嗎？

en: You have five dollars in points available to use.
zh: 您目前有 5 元價值的點數可以折抵使用。

en: Great, please apply that to the total!
zh: 太好了，請幫我直接折抵總金額！

en: Can I get a tax-free / duty-free refund here?
zh: 請問在這裡消費可以辦理退稅嗎？

en: Yes, please show me your passport.
zh: 可以的，請出示您的外國護照。

en: Can I return this if it doesn't fit?
zh: 如果尺寸不合，我可以拿來退貨嗎？

en: Yes, you have thirty days with the original receipt.
zh: 可以的，憑原始發票明細可在 30 天內辦理。

en: Make sure to keep the tags attached.
zh: 請務必確保商品標籤吊牌完整未拆。

en: I'd like to exchange this for a larger size.
zh: 我想把這件換大一號的尺寸。

en: I'd like to return this shirt and get a refund.
zh: 我想把這件衣服退掉並辦理退款。

en: Is there anything wrong with the item?
zh: 請問商品有任何瑕疵或問題嗎？

en: No, it's just the wrong color for my friend.
zh: 沒有，只是顏色不太適合我朋友。

en: No problem, the refund is back on your card.
zh: 沒問題，退款已直接刷退回您的卡片。

en: Where is the checkout counter / cashier?
zh: 請問結帳收銀台在哪裡？

en: The line starts right over there.
zh: 排隊動線是從那邊開始喔。

en: Next customer in line, please!
zh: 下一位排隊的顧客請上前！

en: Do you sell umbrellas here?
zh: 請問你們這裡有賣雨傘嗎？

en: Yes, they're by the entrance door.
zh: 有的，就放在大門口入口處旁邊。

en: How much does a bottle of water cost?
zh: 一瓶礦泉水多少錢？

en: Can you heat up this lunchbox for me, please?
zh: 可以麻煩幫我微波加熱這個便當嗎？

en: Sure, give me about one minute.
zh: 好的，請稍等大約一分鐘。

en: Careful, it's very hot!
zh: 請小心拿，便當非常燙喔！

en: Do you need a pair of chopsticks and a spoon?
zh: 需要附免洗筷子和湯匙給您嗎？

en: Just a fork is fine, thanks!
zh: 只要一支叉子就可以了，謝謝！

en: Can I get a pack of mints at the register?
zh: 我可以順便拿一包收銀台旁邊的薄荷糖嗎？

en: Is this cart free to use?
zh: 這台手推車是可以免費使用的嗎？

en: Yes, just push it out of the rack.
zh: 是的，直接從推車架拉出來用即可。

en: Where can I weigh these fresh apples?
zh: 請問這些新鮮蘋果要在哪裡過磅稱重？

en: The scale is in the center of the produce section.
zh: 電子秤就在生鮮蔬果區的正中央。

en: Is this organic produce?
zh: 這些是產地認證的有機蔬果嗎？

en: Yes, all items on this table are 100% organic.
zh: 是的，這張陳列桌上的蔬果全是百分之百有機的。

en: These avocados are ripe and ready to eat.
zh: 這些酪梨都已經熟成，買回去就可以直接吃了。

en: Do you have fresh milk with a later expiration date?
zh: 有保存期限更久一點的新鮮牛奶嗎？

en: Check the cartons at the very back of the shelf.
zh: 您可以看貨架最裡面的那幾盒。

en: Can I get a discount if I buy in bulk?
zh: 如果我大量批發購買，可以算便宜點打折嗎？

en: If you buy three, you get 20 percent off.
zh: 買滿三件以上可以打八折優惠。

en: Where can I find shampoo and body wash?
zh: 洗髮精和沐浴乳要在哪一排貨架找？

en: Aisle five, on the top shelf.
zh: 在第五走道的最上層貨架。

en: Do you sell travel-sized bottles?
zh: 你們有賣旅行用的小隨身瓶嗎？

en: Yes, right in the travel accessories section.
zh: 有的，就在旅行必備配件專區。

en: Can I get a gift receipt for this item?
zh: 可以幫我開一張禮品收據（不顯示價格）嗎？

en: Do you offer gift wrapping service here?
zh: 請問你們這裡有提供禮物包裝服務嗎？

en: Yes, we have free gift boxes at customer service.
zh: 有的，顧客服務中心有提供免費的禮物盒。

en: I think this item scanned with the wrong price.
zh: 我想這件商品的條碼刷出來價格好像算錯了。

en: Let me double check the shelf tag for you.
zh: 我馬上為您核對一下貨架上的標價標籤。

en: You're right, let me adjust the price for you.
zh: 您說得沒錯，我立刻在收銀機為您修正價格。

en: Thanks for catching that!
zh: 謝謝你發現了這個錯誤！

en: Please enter your PIN on the terminal.
zh: 請在刷卡機螢幕上輸入您的密碼。

en: Please tap or insert your chip card.
zh: 請感應或插入您的晶片信用卡。

en: Your payment has been approved.
zh: 您的付款已授權成功。

en: Would you like your receipt printed or emailed?
zh: 發票要列印紙本還是寄到電子信箱？

en: Printed is fine, thank you.
zh: 印紙本的給我就好，謝謝。

en: Have a great rest of your day shopping!
zh: 祝您今天購物愉快！

en: Thank you, you too!
zh: 謝謝，你也是！

en: Excuse me, what time do you close tonight?
zh: 不好意思，請問你們今晚幾點打烊關門？

en: We're open until 10 PM every day.
zh: 我們每天都營業到晚上 10 點整。

en: Are you open on Sundays and holidays?
zh: 你們週日和國定假日有開門營業嗎？

en: Yes, we're open seven days a week.
zh: 有的，我們全年無休、天天營業。

en: Where is the customer service desk located?
zh: 請問顧客服務諮詢台在哪個位置？

en: It's right near the main entrance on the first floor.
zh: 就在一樓正門大廳入口處旁邊。

en: Thanks so much for your kind help today!
zh: 今天真的很感謝你熱心親切的幫忙！

en: You're very welcome! Have a great day.
zh: 非常不客氣！祝您有個美好的一天。

en: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to Central Station?
zh: 不好意思，請問中央火車站應該要怎麼走？

en: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left.
zh: 直走過兩個街區，然後在路口左轉。

en: Is it within walking distance from here?
zh: 從這裡用走路走得過去嗎？距離近嗎？

en: Yes, it's only about a five-minute walk.
zh: 可以的，走路大概只要五分鐘左右。

en: No, it's quite far. You'd better take the subway.
zh: 不行喔，距離蠻遠的，你最好搭地鐵／捷運。

en: Which subway line should I take to downtown?
zh: 去市中心我應該要搭乘哪一條地鐵線？

en: Take the Blue Line and get off at City Hall.
zh: 搭乘藍線，然後在市政府站下車。

en: Where is the nearest subway entrance?
zh: 請問最近的地鐵站出入口在哪裡？

en: It's just across the street, right next to the bank.
zh: 就在馬路正對面，銀行隔壁就是了。

en: Where can I buy a subway transit pass?
zh: 我在哪裡可以買到地鐵悠遊卡／交通乘車券？

en: You can get one at the ticket vending machine over there.
zh: 您可以在那邊的自動售票機購買。

en: Which bus goes to the international airport?
zh: 請問哪一路公車可以直達國際機場？

en: Bus number 300 goes directly to Terminal 1.
zh: 300 號公車可以直接開到第一航廈。

en: How often does this bus come?
zh: 這班公車大概多久會來一班？

en: It runs every fifteen minutes.
zh: 每十五分鐘就有一班車。

en: Does this bus stop at the National Museum?
zh: 這班公車有停靠國家博物館站嗎？

en: Yes, it's the fourth stop from here.
zh: 有的，從這裡算起第四站就是了。

en: How many stops is it to Times Square?
zh: 到時代廣場總共還要坐幾站？

en: It's three more stops. I'll let you know when to get off.
zh: 還要三站，到了我會提醒你下車。

en: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
zh: 不好意思，請問這裡有人坐嗎？

en: Can I get past you, please? This is my stop.
zh: 不好意思借過一下可以嗎？我這站要下車。

en: Where can I catch a taxi / cab around here?
zh: 請問這附近哪裡可以叫到計程車？

en: There's a taxi stand right in front of the hotel.
zh: 飯店正大門口就有一個專用計程車排班處。

en: Could you call a cab for me, please?
zh: 能麻煩幫我叫一輛計程車嗎？

en: I'm going to 120 Main Street, please.
zh: 麻煩請載我到主街 120 號，謝謝。

en: How long will it take to get there in this traffic?
zh: 以現在的交通路況，開到那裡大概要多久？

en: It should take about twenty minutes.
zh: 大概需要二十分鐘左右。

en: Please turn on the meter.
zh: 請幫我按表跳錶計費，謝謝。

en: Can you drop me off right at the corner?
zh: 可以在那個路口轉角處讓我下車嗎？

en: Pull over right by that convenience store, please.
zh: 麻煩請在前面那家便利商店旁邊靠邊停。

en: How much is the fare?
zh: 車資總共是多少錢？

en: Keep the change, thanks for the smooth ride!
zh: 不用找零錢了，謝謝你開得這麼穩！

en: Can I pay the taxi fare with a credit card?
zh: 計程車車資可以刷信用卡付費嗎？

en: Where can I rent a public bicycle?
zh: 請問哪裡可以租借公共自行車？

en: There's a bike rental station right behind you.
zh: 你正後方就有一個自行車租借站點。

en: How do I unlock the bike with the app?
zh: 我要怎麼用手機 App 來解鎖這輛單車？

en: Just scan the QR code on the handlebar.
zh: 直接用手機掃描車把手上的 QR Code 即可。

en: Is there a bike lane along this river?
zh: 沿著這條河岸邊有自行車專用道嗎？

en: Yes, it's a beautiful and safe path.
zh: 有的，是一條風景優美又安全的車道。

en: Excuse me, I'm completely lost. Can you help me?
zh: 不好意思，我完全迷路了，能幫幫我嗎？

en: Where are you trying to go?
zh: 您想要去哪裡呢？

en: I'm looking for the local art museum.
zh: 我正在尋找當地的市立美術館。

en: You're heading in the opposite direction.
zh: 你現在走的方向完全相反了喔。

en: Turn around and walk back three blocks.
zh: 往回轉走過三個街區。

en: You'll see it on your right hand side.
zh: 你就會在右手邊看到它了。

en: You can't miss it!
zh: 目標非常明顯，你絕對不會錯過的！

en: Is it safe to walk around here at night?
zh: 晚上在這附近一個人走路散步安全嗎？

en: Yes, this neighborhood is very lively and safe.
zh: 很安全，這個街區晚上很熱鬧而且治安很好。

en: Where is the nearest public restroom?
zh: 請問最近的公共廁所在哪裡？

en: There's a clean restroom inside the bookstore.
zh: 那家書店裡面就有乾淨的洗手間。

en: Where is the nearest gas station?
zh: 請問最近的加油站要往哪裡開？

en: Drive straight down this road for two miles.
zh: 沿著這條路直開兩英里就到了。

en: Do you know where the tourist info center is?
zh: 請問你知道旅客服務中心在哪裡嗎？

en: Can I get a free city map here?
zh: 我可以在這裡索取一份免費的市區地圖嗎？

en: What are the top must-visit attractions in this city?
zh: 這座城市排名前幾名的必訪景點有哪些？

en: You should definitely visit the historical old town.
zh: 你絕對一定要去歷史悠久的舊城老街逛逛。

en: How much is the admission ticket for adults?
zh: 成人全票一張門票要多少錢？

en: Are there any student or senior discounts?
zh: 請問有學生優惠票或長者敬老優惠嗎？

en: Do I need to book tickets online in advance?
zh: 我需要提前在網路上預約購票嗎？

en: Yes, tickets sell out very quickly on weekends.
zh: 建議要，因為週末現場門票很快就會被搶光。

en: Is taking photos allowed inside the gallery?
zh: 展覽館裡面是可以拍照攝影的嗎？

en: No flash photography, please.
zh: 請勿使用閃光燈拍照。

en: What time does the last tour bus leave?
zh: 最後一班觀光導覽巴士是幾點發車？

en: The last bus departs at 6 PM sharp.
zh: 末班車在下午 6 點整準時發車。

en: Where can I find lockers to store my luggage?
zh: 請問在哪裡可以找到置物櫃寄放行李？

en: There are coin-operated lockers on basement level one.
zh: 地下一樓有投幣式的大型行李寄物櫃。

en: How much does it cost per hour for parking?
zh: 請問這裡停車一小時收費多少錢？

en: Is there an elevator or escalator nearby?
zh: 請問這附近有電梯或電扶梯嗎？

en: Take the elevator over there to the top floor.
zh: 搭那邊的電梯可以直接抵達頂樓。

en: Traffic is so congested during rush hour.
zh: 尖峰上班時間這條路的交通真是有夠塞。

en: Let's take the subway instead of driving.
zh: 我們別開車了，改搭捷運／地鐵吧。

en: Is this road a one-way street?
zh: 這條馬路是單行道嗎？

en: Yes, watch out for the traffic signs.
zh: 是的，請多留意路邊的交通指示牌。

en: Where can I catch the shuttle bus to the hotel?
zh: 我在哪裡可以搭乘前往飯店的接駁巴士？

en: The shuttle stops at platform B outside exit 3.
zh: 接駁車停靠在 3 號出口外的 B 號月台。

en: How long is the ferry ride to the island?
zh: 搭渡輪坐船到那座島嶼需要多久時間？

en: It takes about thirty minutes on the ferry.
zh: 搭渡輪大約需要三十分鐘的時間。

en: Can we bring bicycles on the ferry?
zh: 我們可以把自行車牽上渡輪一起搭乘嗎？

en: Yes, there's a dedicated area for bikes.
zh: 可以的，船上有自行車專用停放區。

en: Could you point me towards the main shopping street?
zh: 能麻煩幫我指一下主要購物街的方向嗎？

en: Follow this pedestrian street all the way down.
zh: 沿著這條行人徒步區一直往前走到底就是了。

en: Are there any good local restaurants around here?
zh: 這附近有什麼道地好吃的在地小吃餐廳嗎？

en: Try the noodle shop behind the post office.
zh: 去試試郵局後面那家麵館，非常有名。

en: Thanks for the directions, you've been so helpful!
zh: 太感謝你的指路了，真的幫了我大忙！

en: Have a wonderful time exploring our city!
zh: 祝你在我們城市探索遊玩得開心！

en: Which platform does the express train leave from?
zh: 請問特快直達列車是在第幾月台發車？

en: Platform four, on the left side.
zh: 在左側的第四月台。

en: Does this train have free onboard Wi-Fi?
zh: 這列火車上有提供免費的車載 Wi-Fi 嗎？

en: Yes, just connect to the guest network.
zh: 有的，直接連線至訪客網路即可。

en: Where is the dining car on this train?
zh: 請問這列火車的餐車車廂在哪一節？

en: It's car number five, in the middle of the train.
zh: 在第五節車廂，就在整列車的中間位置。

en: Can I change my ticket to an earlier departure?
zh: 我可以把車票改簽到更早出發的班次嗎？

en: Yes, please take your ticket to the service counter.
zh: 可以的，請帶著您的車票至票務櫃檯辦理。

en: Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
zh: 列車進站時請注意月台與車廂間的空隙。

en: We have arrived at our destination.
zh: 我們已經順利抵達目的地了。

en: Double check your seats to make sure you didn't leave anything.
zh: 下車前請仔細檢查座位，確認沒有遺漏個人隨身物品。

en: Have a safe onward journey!
zh: 祝您接下來的旅途一路順風平安！

en: Where is the taxi drop-off area?
zh: 請問計程車下客專用區在哪裡？

en: It's right by the terminal departure doors.
zh: 就在出境航廈大門口旁邊。

en: Thanks for the ride, have a great day!
zh: 謝謝你載我一程，祝你今天順心！

en: Hi! I'd like to check in, please.
zh: 您好！我想辦理入住手續／登機手續。

en: I have a hotel reservation under the name Michael.
zh: 我有預訂房間，登記的名字是 Michael。

en: Here is my passport and booking confirmation.
zh: 這是我的護照與訂房／訂位確認單。

en: What time is check-in and check-out?
zh: 請問入住和退房的時間分別是幾點？

en: Check-in is at 3 PM, and check-out is at 11 AM.
zh: 入住時間是下午 3 點，退房時間是上午 11 點。

en: Is it possible to request an early check-in?
zh: 請問有可能申請提前辦理入住嗎？

en: Can I request a quiet room facing away from the street?
zh: 我可以要求安排一間遠離馬路、安靜一點的客房嗎？

en: Can I get a late check-out tomorrow morning?
zh: 明天早上我可以申請延後退房嗎？

en: Can we store our luggage here until our room is ready?
zh: 在房間準備好前，我們可以先寄放行李嗎？

en: Sure, we'll give you a luggage claim tag.
zh: 當然可以，我們會給您一張行李提領牌。

en: Is breakfast included in our room rate?
zh: 請問我們的房費有包含每日早餐嗎？

en: Where and when is breakfast served?
zh: 請問早餐是在哪裡用餐？供應時間是幾點？

en: Breakfast is served on the second floor from 7 to 10 AM.
zh: 早餐在二樓餐廳供應，時間是早上 7 點到 10 點。

en: What is the Wi-Fi password for the guest rooms?
zh: 請問客房內的 Wi-Fi 無線上網密碼是什麼？

en: It's your room number and your last name.
zh: 帳號密碼是您的房號加上您的姓氏。

en: Could we get an extra blanket and two pillows, please?
zh: 可以幫我們多送一條毯子和兩顆枕頭過來嗎？

en: The air conditioner in our room isn't working.
zh: 我們房間裡的冷氣機好像故障沒有運轉。

en: I'll send a technician up to check it right away.
zh: 我馬上派工程維修人員上去為您檢查。

en: Could you send someone up with fresh towels, please?
zh: 能派人送幾條乾淨的新毛巾上來嗎？

en: There's no hot water in the shower.
zh: 淋浴間的水龍頭完全沒有熱水出來。

en: We're on the tenth floor, room 1008.
zh: 我們住在十樓，房號是 1008。

en: Is there a gym or swimming pool in the hotel?
zh: 請問飯店裡面有健身房或游泳池嗎？

en: Yes, the fitness center is on the third floor.
zh: 有的，健身中心位於三樓。

en: What are the opening hours for the pool?
zh: 請問游泳池的開放時間是幾點到幾點？

en: It's open from 6 AM until 10 PM daily.
zh: 每天從早上 6 點開放至晚上 10 點。

en: Could you arrange a wake-up call for 6:30 AM tomorrow?
zh: 能幫我設定明天早上 6 點半的電話叫醒服務嗎？

en: We're checking out now. Everything was great.
zh: 我們現在要辦理退房結帳了，一切都很棒。

en: Here are our room key cards, thank you.
zh: 這是我們的房間房卡，非常感謝。

en: Can you call a taxi to the airport for us?
zh: 能幫我們叫一輛前往機場的計程車嗎？

en: I'd like to check in for my flight to Tokyo.
zh: 我想辦理搭乘前往東京航班的登機手續。

en: Window seat or aisle seat, which do you prefer?
zh: 靠窗座位還是走道座位，您比較偏好哪一種？

en: A window seat near the front, if available.
zh: 如果有位子的話，希望能選靠前面的靠窗座位。

en: Can my travel companion and I sit together?
zh: 我和同行旅伴的座位可以被安排坐在一起嗎？

en: Do you have any bags to check in today?
zh: 請問您今天有任何需要託運的大件行李嗎？

en: Just this one suitcase, and one carry-on bag.
zh: 就這一件託運行李箱，還有一件隨身手提行李。

en: Please place your luggage on the scale.
zh: 請將您的行李箱平放在電子磅秤上。

en: Your suitcase is slightly overweight.
zh: 您的行李箱稍微有點超重了喔。

en: Can I take some heavy items out and put them in my carry-on?
zh: 我可以把一些重的物品拿出來放進隨身包裡嗎？

en: Yes, go right ahead and repack over there.
zh: 可以的，您可以到旁邊去重新整理打包。

en: Do you have any liquids or electronics in your checked bag?
zh: 您的託運行李裡面有放置任何液體或電子產品嗎？

en: No, all laptops and power banks are in my backpack.
zh: 沒有，所有筆記型電腦和行動電源都在我的後背包裡。

en: Here is your boarding pass and luggage tags.
zh: 這是您的登機證和行李託運收據條。

en: Your flight departs from Gate 24 at 10:15.
zh: 您的班機將於 10 點 15 分在 24 號登機門起飛。

en: Boarding starts forty minutes prior to departure.
zh: 飛機將在起飛前四十分鐘開始登機。

en: Where is security checkpoint and passport control?
zh: 請問安全檢查走道和護照查驗處在哪裡？

en: Follow the signs straight ahead on the right.
zh: 順著正前方右側的指示指標走就到了。

en: Please take off your shoes, belt, and jacket.
zh: 過安檢時請脫下您的鞋子、皮帶與厚外套。

en: Take out your laptop and place it in a separate bin.
zh: 請將筆記型電腦拿出來，單獨放置在專用置物籃中。

en: Empty all your pockets before stepping through the scanner.
zh: 走過安檢門金屬探測器前，請清空身上所有口袋。

en: Where is the duty-free shopping area?
zh: 請問免稅商店購物專區在哪個區域？

en: It's right past the security check area.
zh: 一通過安檢區就可以看到整排免稅店了。

en: Can I buy duty-free perfume and cosmetics here?
zh: 我在這裡可以購買免稅香水和化妝保養品嗎？

en: Where is the airline lounge for business class?
zh: 請問商務艙專屬貴賓室在哪個位置？

en: It's on the upper mezzanine near Gate 15.
zh: 在靠近 15 號登機門上方的夾層樓。

en: Is our flight on time, or is it delayed?
zh: 請問我們的航班有準時嗎？還是有延誤？

en: The flight is delayed by forty-five minutes due to weather.
zh: 因為氣候因素，航班預計將延誤四十五分鐘。

en: Has the boarding gate been changed for flight 205?
zh: 請問 205 號航班的登機門有變更嗎？

en: Yes, it was moved from Gate 12 to Gate 18.
zh: 是的，已經從 12 號門改移至 18 號登機門。

en: Now boarding group one and passengers with small children.
zh: 現在開始邀請第一區乘客以及攜帶幼童的家庭登機。

en: Please have your passport and boarding pass in hand.
zh: 登機時請將您的護照和登機證提前拿在手上。

en: Excuse me, where can I put my small backpack?
zh: 不好意思，請問我的小後背包可以放在哪裡？

en: Under the seat in front of you, please.
zh: 請直接放在您正前方的座椅下方即可。

en: Could you help me put my bag in the overhead bin?
zh: 能請您幫忙把我的手提行李放進頭頂置物櫃嗎？

en: Please fasten your seatbelt and return your seat to the upright position.
zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶，並將椅背豎直。

en: Can I get a blanket and a pair of headphones, please?
zh: 可以給我一條小毛毯和一副耳機嗎？

en: Chicken or pasta for your dinner tonight?
zh: 您今晚的主餐想選雞肉飯還是義大利麵？

en: Chicken with rice, please. And a cup of hot green tea.
zh: 我要雞肉飯，謝謝。並請給我一杯熱綠茶。

en: Could I get a glass of apple juice, please?
zh: 可以給我一杯蘋果汁嗎？

en: Excuse me, could I get past to use the lavatory?
zh: 不好意思借過一下，我想去使用洗手間。

en: We will be landing in approximately twenty minutes.
zh: 我們預計將在大約二十分鐘後降落。

en: Welcome to Los Angeles! Local time is 8 PM.
zh: 歡迎抵達洛杉磯！當地現在時間是晚上 8 點整。

en: Where is the immigration line for foreign visitors?
zh: 請問外國旅客入境查驗隊伍是在哪一邊排隊？

en: What is the purpose of your visit?
zh: 請問您這次入境旅行的目的是什麼？

en: I'm here for tourism and sightseeing with my family.
zh: 我和家人是來這裡觀光旅遊度假的。

en: How long do you intend to stay in the country?
zh: 您預計要在這個國家停留多長的時間？

en: I'll be staying here for ten days.
zh: 我預計總共會停留十天的時間。

en: Where will you be staying during your trip?
zh: 這趟旅程中您都將住在哪些地方？

en: At the Grand Hotel downtown. Here is my booking.
zh: 住在市中心的大飯店，這是我的訂房憑證。

en: Enjoy your stay and have a wonderful trip!
zh: 祝您居留愉快，旅途平安順心！

en: Where is baggage claim carousel number four?
zh: 請問第四號行李提領轉盤要在哪裡找？

en: It's straight down the escalators on level one.
zh: 順著手扶梯直接搭到一樓就是了。

en: I've been waiting for forty minutes, but my suitcase hasn't arrived.
zh: 我已經等了四十分鐘，但我的行李箱一直沒出來。

en: Where is the lost and found / baggage service desk?
zh: 請問遺失物中心／行李服務諮詢處在哪裡？

en: My luggage seems to be lost or delayed.
zh: 我的行李好像遺失或是被延誤轉運了。

en: Please fill out this property irregularity report.
zh: 請協助填寫這份行李事故申報單。

en: What color and brand is your missing suitcase?
zh: 請問您遺失的行李箱是什麼顏色和廠牌？

en: It's a large black Samsonite hard-shell suitcase.
zh: 是一個黑色大型的新秀麗硬殼行李箱。

en: We will deliver it directly to your hotel once it arrives.
zh: 一旦行李運抵，我們會第一時間直接派送至您的飯店。

en: Thank you so much for your assistance.
zh: 非常感謝您耐心親切的協助。

en: Where is the currency exchange counter?
zh: 請問外幣兌換櫃檯在哪個區域？

en: Where can I buy a local prepaid tourist SIM card / eSIM?
zh: 我在哪裡可以購買當地的預付上網 SIM 卡或 eSIM？

en: There are multiple telecom kiosks right by exit doors.
zh: 出境大廳各出口旁邊就有好幾家通訊業者的攤位。

en: How much for unlimited data for seven days?
zh: 七天吃到飽無限上網方案要多少錢？

en: Can you help me install and activate it on my phone?
zh: 可以幫我在手機上安裝並開通啟用嗎？

en: Where can I catch an Uber or airport taxi?
zh: 請問要在哪裡搭乘 Uber 或機場排班計程車？

en: Follow the rideshare pickup signs on level two.
zh: 跟著二樓的 Rideshare 網約車專用上車指標走即可。

en: I ordered an Uber, it says it will arrive in three minutes.
zh: 我剛剛叫了一輛 Uber，App 顯示三分鐘後會抵達。

en: Look for a white Toyota with license plate 8899.
zh: 請注意找一輛車牌號碼 8899 的白色豐田轎車。

en: Put your bags in the trunk and hop in!
zh: 把行李放進後車廂，趕快上車吧！

en: Thanks, let's head to our hotel and get some rest!
zh: 謝謝，那我們出發前往飯店好好休息吧！

en: Good morning everyone! Let's get started.
zh: 大家早安！我們準備開始開會囉。

en: Can everyone hear me clearly on the call?
zh: 線上通話的各位都能清楚聽到我的聲音嗎？

en: Sorry about that, I was on mute!
zh: 不好意思，我剛剛不小心按到靜音了！

en: Could you please share your screen with us?
zh: 能麻煩你在線上分享一下你的螢幕畫面嗎？

en: Can everyone see my slides now?
zh: 大家現在都能看到我的簡報投影片了嗎？

en: Yes, it's coming through loud and clear.
zh: 看到了，畫面和聲音都非常清晰順暢。

en: Let's quickly go over today's agenda.
zh: 我們快速過一下今天會議要討論的各項議程。

en: Could you send me that link in the Slack chat?
zh: 可以麻煩把那個連結貼在 Slack 聊天室給我嗎？

en: I'll attach the PDF file in the follow-up email.
zh: 我會在會後的追蹤郵件中附上這份 PDF 檔案。

en: Let's touch base on this project tomorrow morning.
zh: 關於這個專案，我們明早再來簡短對焦碰一下。

en: Are you free for a quick five-minute sync?
zh: 你有空進行五分鐘的快速同步確認嗎？

en: Let's jump on a quick call to sort this out.
zh: 我們直接打個簡短通話把這件事搞定吧。

en: What's the deadline for submitting this proposal?
zh: 提交這份提案企劃案的截止日期是何時？

en: The hard deadline is Friday by 5 PM.
zh: 最晚的死線是本週五下午 5 點整。

en: I'm currently working on the final draft.
zh: 我目前正在趕工做最後一份修訂草稿。

en: Could you take a quick look and give me some feedback?
zh: 能請你幫我快速看一下並給我一些回饋建議嗎？

en: Looks great to me, just a few minor typos.
zh: 整體看起來很棒，只發現幾個小小的錯字而已。

en: Thanks for catching those! I'll fix them right away.
zh: 謝謝你抓出來！我馬上把它們修正好。

en: I'm swamped with meetings all afternoon today.
zh: 我今天整個下午都被各種會議塞爆了。

en: Let's push our 1-on-1 meeting to next Monday.
zh: 我們把一對一會談順延改到下週一吧。

en: Does 2 PM work for you, or is 3 PM better?
zh: 下午 2 點對你方便嗎？還是 3 點比較好？

en: Either time works great for me, send an invite!
zh: 兩個時間我都可以，發行事曆邀請給我吧！

en: I'll send over a calendar invite shortly.
zh: 我稍後會發送 Google Calendar 會議邀請過去。

en: I'll be out of the office starting tomorrow afternoon.
zh: 我明天下午開始會請假不在辦公室。

en: If anything urgent comes up, message me on Teams.
zh: 如果有任何緊急突發狀況，可以在 Teams 上私訊我。

en: I'll be covering for Sarah while she is on leave.
zh: 在 Sarah 休假這段期間，我會代理處理她的業務。

en: Who is the main point of contact for this client?
zh: 請問這個客戶窗口的主要負責人是誰？

en: David is leading this account, so check with him.
zh: David 是負責這個客戶的主管，去跟他確認吧。

en: Let's loop Emily into this email thread.
zh: 我們把 Emily 也加入這個郵件討論串中吧。

en: Keep me in the loop regarding any new updates.
zh: 有任何最新後續進展，請隨時讓我保持知情。

en: I'll keep you posted as soon as I hear back.
zh: 一旦收到對方的回覆，我會立刻跟你通報。

en: Let's wrap up today's meeting and take action items.
zh: 我們今天會議就開到這裡，來整理行動代辦清單。

en: Who wants to take ownership of this task?
zh: 有誰想要主導認領這項工作任務嗎？

en: I can handle that part, no problem!
zh: 那一塊我可以來負責搞定，沒問題！

en: Thanks for stepping up and taking the lead on this.
zh: 謝謝你主動挺身而出挑起這項大樑。

en: Let's schedule a follow-up meeting for next Thursday.
zh: 我們把下次追蹤進度會議定在下週四。

en: I'll send out the meeting minutes by the end of the day.
zh: 我會在今天下班前把會議記錄整理寄給各位。

en: Could you resend that spreadsheet? I can't open it.
zh: 可以麻煩重寄那份試算表嗎？我這邊開不起來。

en: Check your inbox now, I just resent it.
zh: 現在看你的信箱，我剛剛已經重新寄出了。

en: Got it, thanks! It works perfectly now.
zh: 收到了，謝謝！現在可以正常打開了。

en: Let's brainstorm some creative ideas for the campaign.
zh: 我們一起為這次行銷活動腦力激盪想些創意吧。

en: There are no bad ideas in a brainstorm session.
zh: 在腦力激盪討論時，沒有任何點子是不好的。

en: What if we collaborated with local coffee brands?
zh: 如果我們和在地的知名咖啡品牌跨界聯名呢？

en: I love that idea! That could really drive engagement.
zh: 我超愛這個點子！這絕對能大幅提升互動率。

en: Let's run a small pilot test before launching fully.
zh: 在全面正式上線推廣之前，我們先做小規模試跑。

en: That's a very smart and safe approach.
zh: 那是個非常聰明又穩妥的做法。

en: We need to cut down unnecessary expenses this quarter.
zh: 我們這季必須設法縮減不必要的開銷支出。

en: Let's review our software subscriptions.
zh: 我們來逐一盤點審視一下公司訂閱的各項軟體服務。

en: We can cancel the tools that nobody uses.
zh: 我們可以退訂那些根本沒人在用的冷門工具。

en: That will save us a few thousand dollars a month.
zh: 那樣每個月至少能幫公司省下好幾千美元。

en: How are we tracking against our monthly target?
zh: 我們這個月的業績目標目前達成率追蹤得如何？

en: We're currently at 85 percent of our goal.
zh: 我們目前已經達到了既定目標的 85%。

en: With one week left, we can definitely hit 100%.
zh: 還剩下一週時間，我們絕對有機會拚到百分之百。

en: Let's push hard for the finish line!
zh: 大家一起加把勁，全力衝刺達標！

en: Great presentation today! You handled questions very well.
zh: 今天的簡報太精采了！你問題回答得真得體。

en: Thanks! I practiced a lot with my mentor.
zh: 謝謝！我和我的導師私底下演練了很久。

en: Your hard work really paid off.
zh: 你的辛苦努力真的換來了甜美的回報。

en: I appreciate your quick turnaround on this request.
zh: 非常感謝你這麼迅速就處理完這項需求。

en: Happy to help anytime!
zh: 隨時樂意幫忙！

en: Could you grant me edit access to the shared folder?
zh: 可以開給我那個共享資料夾的編輯修改權限嗎？

en: Just sent you full access permissions.
zh: 剛剛已經把完整的編輯權限開通發給你了。

en: Let me know if you run into any access issues.
zh: 如果權限上有遇到任何問題，隨時跟我說。

en: The server is down temporarily for maintenance.
zh: 伺服器目前正因例行維護而暫時離線。

en: It should be back online within thirty minutes.
zh: 預計在三十分鐘之內就會重新恢復連線。

en: Thanks for the update, I'll let the team know.
zh: 謝謝你的最新通知，我這就去轉告團隊同仁。

en: Please review the attached contract before signing.
zh: 在正式簽字之前，請仔細審閱附件中的合約條款。

en: Our legal counsel approved the revised draft.
zh: 我們的法務顧問已經審核通過修改後的最新版本。

en: We're ready to proceed with the signing.
zh: 我們隨時可以進行後續的正式簽約流程。

en: Let's get the digital signature done today.
zh: 我們今天就把電子簽名流程跑完吧。

en: Welcome to our company! We're thrilled to have you.
zh: 熱烈歡迎加入我們公司！非常高興你的到來。

en: Here is your laptop and your security badge.
zh: 這是為你配置的筆記型電腦和員工識別證。

en: Let me show you around the office space.
zh: 我帶你參觀一下整個辦公室環境與各部門。

en: This is the kitchen where we grab coffee and snacks.
zh: 這裡是茶水間，大家都在這裡泡咖啡吃點心。

en: Feel free to ask anyone if you need help settling in.
zh: 剛入職如果有任何不熟悉的地方，儘管開口問大家。

en: Everyone here is super friendly and supportive.
zh: 這裡的每個人都超級友善而且很樂於助人。

en: Thanks so much! I'm really excited to get started.
zh: 非常感謝！我超級期待正式展開工作。

en: Let's do a quick daily stand-up meeting at 9:30.
zh: 我們每天早上 9 點半開個簡短的站立晨會。

en: What did you work on yesterday?
zh: 你昨天主要處理了哪些工作進度？

en: I finished testing the new payment feature.
zh: 我昨天完成了新支付功能的全面測試。

en: Are there any blockers preventing you from moving forward?
zh: 目前手上有遇到任何卡關阻礙前進的問題嗎？

en: No blockers on my end, everything is smooth.
zh: 我這邊完全沒有卡關，一切都很順暢。

en: I'm waiting on approval from the finance department.
zh: 我目前正在等待財務部門的核准簽核。

en: I'll ping the finance manager to expedite it.
zh: 我去敲一下財務經理幫忙催件加速流程。

en: Thanks, that would really speed things up!
zh: 太感謝了，那樣一定能大幅加快進度！

en: Let's make sure we hit our quarterly launch date.
zh: 我們務必確保專案能在本季預定的上線日期發布。

en: Quality comes first, but speed is also crucial.
zh: 品質絕對擺第一，但執行速度同樣至關重要。

en: Let's do a retrospection meeting next week.
zh: 下週我們來開個專案復盤檢討會。

en: What went well, and what could we improve?
zh: 哪些地方做得很好？哪些環節我們還可以改進？

en: I think our cross-team communication was much better.
zh: 我覺得這次跨團隊的溝通效率比以往進步很多。

en: We should automate our testing workflow next time.
zh: 我們下次應該把測試流程進一步自動化。

en: Agreed, let's put that in our next sprint backlog.
zh: 完全贊成，我們把它排進下個衝刺週期的待辦事項。

en: Thank you for your dedication to this launch.
zh: 非常感謝大家為了這次成功上線所付出的辛勞！

en: Let's celebrate with team pizza on Friday!
zh: 本週五我們訂披薩來好好犒賞慶祝一下！

en: Sounds like a great plan, count me in!
zh: 聽起來太棒了，絕對算我一份！

en: I'll place the pizza order for the whole team.
zh: 我來負責幫整個團隊訂披薩外送。

en: Let's keep up the great momentum into next month.
zh: 讓我們把這股絕佳的氣勢與衝勁延續到下個月！

en: Good job everyone, have a great evening!
zh: 大家辛苦了表現超棒，祝各位有個愉快的下班夜晚！

en: See you all bright and early tomorrow morning.
zh: 明天一早見，大家養足精神！

en: Have a restful weekend, don't check your emails!
zh: 週末好好徹底休息放空，千萬別收工作信！

en: I promise I won't open my laptop until Monday!
zh: 我保證週一前絕對不把筆電打開！

en: Hey! Are you free to talk right now?
zh: 嗨！你現在方便講電話／聊天嗎？

en: Sorry, I'm in a meeting. Can I call you back in twenty minutes?
zh: 抱歉我正在開會，二十分鐘後回電給你方便嗎？

en: Sure, take your time! Call me whenever you're done.
zh: 當然，你先忙！忙完了隨時打給我。

en: Hey, I can barely hear you. The connection is really bad.
zh: 喂，我幾乎聽不太清楚你的聲音，訊號很差。

en: Let me call you right back on regular cell service.
zh: 我掛掉改用手機門號直接打給你。

en: Is this better now? Can you hear me clearly?
zh: 現在這樣有好一點嗎？聽得清楚嗎？

en: Yes, much better! What's up?
zh: 有，清楚多了！怎麼啦，有什麼事嗎？

en: Are we still on for dinner tonight?
zh: 我們今晚約吃晚餐的局還有照常進行嗎？

en: Yes, absolutely! Where do you want to meet?
zh: 當然有啊！你想約在哪裡碰面？

en: Let's meet in front of the bookstore at seven.
zh: 那我們晚上七點在書店大門口見。

en: Sounds perfect! See you there at seven.
zh: 太完美了！那我們七點那裡見。

en: I'm running about ten minutes behind schedule, so sorry!
zh: 我路上耽擱了大概會遲到十分鐘，真是不好意思！

en: No worries at all, take your time! I'm already seated.
zh: 完全沒關係，你慢慢來！我已經先入座了。

en: I just arrived! Where are you sitting?
zh: 我剛走進來了！你坐在哪一桌？

en: I'm by the window in the back corner.
zh: 我在最裡面靠窗的那個角落位子。

en: I see you! Waving at you right now.
zh: 我看到你了！我現在正跟你揮手。

en: Could you send me the address / Google Maps pin?
zh: 可以把詳細地址／Google 地圖定位傳給我嗎？

en: Just sent the location link to your WhatsApp.
zh: 我剛剛已經把定位連結傳到你的通訊軟體了。

en: Got it, on my way now! GPS says fifteen minutes.
zh: 收到了，出發中！導航顯示十五分鐘後會到。

en: My phone battery is at 5 percent, it's about to die.
zh: 我手機電量只剩 5%，快要沒電自動關機了。

en: If I don't reply, I'll charge it in my car.
zh: 如果我等等沒回訊息，是我在車上充電中。

en: Do you have a portable power bank on you?
zh: 你身上有帶行動電源隨身充嗎？

en: Yeah, I have an extra charging cable you can use.
zh: 有啊，我有多帶一條充電線可以借你用。

en: Shoot me a text when you leave your house.
zh: 你一走出家門口就傳個簡訊跟我說一聲。

en: Leaving right now! See you in a bit.
zh: 現在出門囉！待會見。

en: Can we reschedule our coffee date to tomorrow?
zh: 我們可以把喝咖啡的約改約到明天嗎？

en: Something came up at home that I need to take care of.
zh: 家裡臨時有點突發狀況需要我趕回去處理一下。

en: Of course! Hope everything is okay at home.
zh: 當然沒問題！希望家裡一切都好。

en: Thanks for understanding, I really appreciate it.
zh: 謝謝你的體諒，真的太感謝了。

en: Let's check in tomorrow morning and pick a new time.
zh: 我們明早再來聯絡對時間，重新約一個時段。

en: Did you get my voice message from earlier?
zh: 你有收到我剛發給你的那段語音訊息嗎？

en: Sorry, I was driving. Let me listen to it now.
zh: 抱歉我剛剛在開車，我現在馬上聽。

en: I left you a voicemail, give me a ring when free.
zh: 我留了語音信箱給你，有空時回撥通電話給我。

en: Who was calling you just now?
zh: 剛剛是誰打電話找你啊？

en: It was just a spam caller trying to sell insurance.
zh: 只是推銷保險的騷擾垃圾電話而已啦。

en: I get so many spam robocalls every day.
zh: 我每天也接到超級多這種詐騙或推銷機器人電話。

en: You should block that unknown number.
zh: 你應該要把那個陌生號碼直接封鎖掉。

en: I'll text you the recipe later tonight.
zh: 我今晚晚點會把食譜做法傳訊息給你。

en: Please remind me if I forget to send it!
zh: 如果我等等忘記傳了，記得提醒我一下喔！

en: I set a reminder on my phone so I won't forget.
zh: 我在手機裡設了提醒鬧鐘，這樣就不會忘了。

en: Are you in the group chat for the weekend trip?
zh: 你有在我們這趟週末出遊的群組聊天室裡面嗎？

en: Not yet! Could you please add me to the group?
zh: 還沒耶！能麻煩你把我拉進群組裡嗎？

en: Just added you. Check out the pinned announcement.
zh: 剛剛把你加進去了，看一下置頂的公告訊息。

en: I voted on the lunch poll in the chat.
zh: 我剛剛已經在群組裡的午餐投票投好票了。

en: Most people want to go for Korean BBQ.
zh: 大部分的人都想去吃韓式烤肉。

en: Korean BBQ sounds delicious! I'm totally down.
zh: 韓式烤肉聽起來超讚！我完全贊成。

en: What time should we all meet up on Saturday?
zh: 我們週六大家應該幾點集合出發？

en: Let's meet at the train station at 8:30 AM sharp.
zh: 我們早上 8 點半在火車站準時集合。

en: Please don't be late! The train won't wait.
zh: 千萬別遲到喔！火車是不等人開走的。

en: I'll set three alarms just to be sure.
zh: 為了以防萬一，我會設三個鬧鐘。

en: Did you see the photo I posted on Instagram?
zh: 你有看到我剛在 IG 上發的那張照片嗎？

en: Yes! That sunset photo looked absolutely stunning.
zh: 有啊！那張夕陽的照片拍得實在太美了。

en: Where was that taken?
zh: 那是在哪裡拍的呀？

en: At the rooftop bar near the harbor.
zh: 在港口附近那家頂樓景觀酒吧拍的。

en: We should go there together next time.
zh: 我們下次一定要一起去那裡坐坐。

en: Can I FaceTime / video call you for a second?
zh: 我可以撥視訊電話給你一分鐘嗎？

en: Sure, give me two minutes to put on a shirt!
zh: 可以，給我兩分鐘穿件衣服！

en: I'm calling you on video right now.
zh: 我現在視訊撥過去囉。

en: Can you see my screen while I show you this app?
zh: 我操作給你看這個 App 時，你能看清畫面嗎？

en: Yes, it's very clear! That looks super useful.
zh: 看得到，很清楚！那個工具看起來真方便。

en: I'll send you the download link.
zh: 我等等把下載連結傳給你。

en: Thanks for sharing that with me.
zh: 謝謝你跟我分享這個好東西。

en: Call me when you get off work.
zh: 你下班後記得打電話給我。

en: I'll be off in about an hour.
zh: 我大概再一個小時左右就下班了。

en: Take your time, no rush.
zh: 慢慢來，不用著急。

en: I sent you an email with the flight tickets.
zh: 我已經把電子機票用 Email 寄到你信箱了。

en: I'll save them to my phone wallet right now.
zh: 我現在馬上把它們存進我的手機錢包裡。

en: Are you free for lunch tomorrow?
zh: 你明天中午有空一起吃午餐嗎？

en: Tomorrow works great! Where do you want to go?
zh: 明天很可以！你想去哪裡吃？

en: How about that sushi place near your office?
zh: 你辦公室附近那家壽司店如何？

en: Sounds like a plan! Let's meet at noon.
zh: 好提議！那我們明天中午十二點見。

en: I'll book a table under my name.
zh: 我會先用我的名字預訂一張桌子。

en: Thanks for making the reservation!
zh: 謝謝你幫忙訂位！

en: See you tomorrow at twelve!
zh: 明天十二點見囉！

en: My phone is lagging, let me restart it.
zh: 我手機現在有點卡頓，我重新開機一下。

en: Message me on my laptop if you need me.
zh: 如果你急著找我，可以用電腦傳訊息給我。

en: I'll be offline for the next two hours on a flight.
zh: 我接下來兩個小時在飛機上會處於離線狀態。

en: Safe travels! Text me when you land.
zh: 旅途平安！落地後記得傳個訊息報平安。

en: Just landed and got my bags!
zh: 我剛順利降落，也拿到行李了！

en: Awesome, welcome home!
zh: 太棒了，歡迎回到家！

en: Call me as soon as you have a free minute.
zh: 只要你有空檔，第一時間打通電話給我。

en: Is everything alright? Sounds urgent.
zh: 一切都還好嗎？聽起來好像蠻緊急的。

en: Everything is fine, just wanted to share some good news!
zh: 沒事沒事一切都很好，只是想跟你分享一個大好消息！

en: You scared me for a second! Tell me all about it.
zh: 你剛剛嚇了我一跳！快說，是什麼好消息？

en: I got the job offer!
zh: 我拿到那份工作的錄取通知了！

en: OMG, congratulations! That is huge news!
zh: 天啊，太恭喜你了！這真是天大的好消息！

en: We definitely have to celebrate this weekend.
zh: 我們這週末一定要出門好好慶祝一番！

en: Dinner is on me to celebrate!
zh: 這頓慶祝晚餐全由我來買單！

en: I can't wait! Let's talk more tonight.
zh: 太期待了！我們今晚再詳聊。

en: Talk to you tonight, bye for now!
zh: 今晚聊，先拜拜囉！

en: Can you give me his phone number?
zh: 你能把他個人的手機電話號碼給我嗎？

en: I'll send his contact card over right away.
zh: 我馬上把他的電子聯絡人名片分享傳給你。

en: Did you save my new phone number?
zh: 你有存我換的這支新手機號碼了嗎？

en: Yes, I updated your contact in my address book.
zh: 有，我已經在通訊錄裡更新你的聯絡資訊了。

en: Let me know if this number works for texting.
zh: 跟我說一聲這個號碼能不能正常收發簡訊。

en: Yep, loud and clear! Message received.
zh: 可以，訊息完全正常收到了！

en: I'm driving right now, so I'll text you when I park.
zh: 我現在正在開車，停好車後我再傳訊息給你。

en: Drive safely and take your time.
zh: 開車注意安全，慢慢開不急。

en: All parked! heading inside the mall now.
zh: 停好車了！我現在正走進購物中心裡。

en: See you by the fountain on the ground floor!
zh: 一樓噴水池旁邊見囉！

en: I need to do my laundry and fold my clothes tonight.
zh: 我今晚得洗衣服並把衣服摺好。

en: Could you take out the trash on your way out?
zh: 出門時能順便幫忙把垃圾拿出去丟嗎？

en: Don't forget to lock the front door when you leave.
zh: 出門離開時別忘了把大門鎖好。

en: Can you turn on the air conditioner? It's burning hot in here.
zh: 可以開冷氣嗎？這裡面真的熱翻了。

en: Could you turn down the heater a little bit?
zh: 可以把暖氣稍微調小一點點嗎？

en: I'm making dinner tonight, do you want to join?
zh: 我今晚要自己下廚煮晚餐，你要一起吃嗎？

en: What are you making? It smells amazing!
zh: 你在煮什麼好料的？聞起來好香喔！

en: I'm cooking garlic butter shrimp pasta.
zh: 我正在煮蒜香奶油鮮蝦義大利麵。

en: Can I help you chop the vegetables or set the table?
zh: 我能幫你切切蔬菜或是擺放餐具嗎？

en: Could you please wash the dishes after dinner?
zh: 吃完晚餐後能麻煩你幫忙洗碗嗎？

en: Sure, I'll take care of the kitchen cleanup.
zh: 沒問題，廚房的清理收拾就交給我負責。

en: We're out of eggs and milk. I need to run to the grocery store.
zh: 家裡的雞蛋和牛奶吃完了，我得跑一趟超市採買。

en: Can you pick up some bananas while you're there?
zh: 你去超市時可以順便幫我買幾根香蕉嗎？

en: I'm going to vacuum the living room and mop the floor.
zh: 我打算把客廳吸一吸地，然後拖一下地板。

en: I didn't sleep well last night, I kept tossing and turning.
zh: 我昨晚睡得很不好，整夜翻來覆去睡不著。

en: You should try going to bed earlier tonight.
zh: 你今晚應該試著早點上床睡覺。

en: I have a terrible headache and feel dizzy today.
zh: 我今天頭痛得很厲害，而且感到有些頭暈。

en: Have you taken any pain relievers yet?
zh: 你吃過止痛藥了嗎？

en: I took some aspirin with water an hour ago.
zh: 我一個小時前有配溫水吃了一顆阿斯匹靈。

en: You look pale; you should probably lie down and rest.
zh: 你的臉色看起來很蒼白，你應該去躺著好好休息。

en: I have a sore throat and a runny nose.
zh: 我喉嚨很痛，而且一直在流鼻水。

en: Drink plenty of warm water with honey and lemon.
zh: 多喝加了蜂蜜和檸檬的溫開水。

en: I think I have a slight fever. Let me check my temperature.
zh: 我覺得我好像有點發燒，我來量一下體溫。

en: The thermometer says 38 degrees Celsius.
zh: 體溫計顯示是攝氏 38 度。

en: You should definitely see a doctor this afternoon.
zh: 你今天下午絕對應該去看一下醫生。

en: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Smith today.
zh: 我想預約今天看 Smith 醫師的門診。

en: Do you have any openings available around 4 PM?
zh: 請問下午 4 點左右有任何可預約的看診時段嗎？

en: What symptoms are you experiencing right now?
zh: 請問您目前出現了哪些不適的症狀？

en: I've had a bad cough and fever for two days.
zh: 我已經嚴重咳嗽和發燒連續兩天了。

en: Are you allergic to any medications?
zh: 請問您對任何藥物有過敏史嗎？

en: No known drug allergies, as far as I know.
zh: 就我所知，我沒有對任何藥物過敏。

en: Please take this medication three times a day after meals.
zh: 請照這份處方三餐飯後服用此藥物，一日三次。

en: Will this medicine make me drowsy?
zh: 吃了這種藥會讓我感到昏昏欲睡想睡覺嗎？

en: Yes, so please avoid driving after taking it.
zh: 會的，所以服藥後請避免親自開車駕駛。

en: I need to pick up my prescription at the pharmacy.
zh: 我需要去藥局領取我的處方藥品。

en: Where is the nearest 24-hour pharmacy?
zh: 請問最近的 24 小時營業藥局在哪裡？

en: I have a dentist appointment for a teeth cleaning tomorrow.
zh: 我明天有預約牙醫要做例行洗牙檢查。

en: Remember to brush your teeth and floss every night.
zh: 記得每天晚上睡前都要刷牙並使用牙線清潔。

en: My lower back really hurts from sitting all day.
zh: 在辦公桌前久坐了一整天，我的下背部好痠痛。

en: You should do some gentle stretches and walk around.
zh: 你應該做一些溫和的伸展拉筋，起身走動走動。

en: I love going for a morning jog in the neighborhood park.
zh: 我很喜歡早上去社區公園慢跑晨練。

en: How many miles do you usually run?
zh: 你平時慢跑通常都跑幾英里／幾公里？

en: I usually run about three miles every other day.
zh: 我通常隔天跑一次，每次大概跑三英里。

en: Working out regularly gives me so much energy.
zh: 規律運動鍛鍊給了我充沛滿滿的活力。

en: I'm trying to cut back on sugary drinks and soda.
zh: 我目前正在努力減少喝含糖飲料和汽水。

en: Drinking more water makes your skin look so much healthier.
zh: 多喝水會讓你的皮膚看起來健康光澤許多。

en: I always keep a reusable water bottle by my desk.
zh: 我總是在辦公桌旁放一個環保隨身水壺。

en: Don't forget to apply sunscreen before going outside.
zh: 出門前千萬別忘了全身塗抹防曬乳液。

en: The UV index is really high today.
zh: 今天的紫外線指數真的非常高。

en: I wear sunglasses to protect my eyes from the bright glare.
zh: 我戴太陽眼鏡是為了保護眼睛免受強烈刺眼光線傷害。

en: I'm going to take a twenty-minute power nap.
zh: 我準備來小睡補眠二十分鐘充電一下。

en: Set an alarm so you don't oversleep!
zh: 設個鬧鐘，這樣才不會不小心睡過頭！

en: Waking up from a short nap makes me feel brand new.
zh: 小睡醒來後，整個人感覺脫胎換骨、神清氣爽。

en: I like listening to relaxing music while reading in bed.
zh: 我喜歡躺在床上看書時聽些讓人放鬆的輕音樂。

en: A hot chamomile tea helps me fall asleep faster.
zh: 喝一杯溫熱的洋甘菊茶能幫助我更快入睡。

en: Turn off all the lights and close the curtains.
zh: 把所有的燈都關掉，並把窗簾拉好。

en: Good night! Sleep tight and have sweet dreams.
zh: 晚安！睡個好覺，祝你好夢。

en: My alarm went off at 6:30 this morning.
zh: 今天早上我的鬧鐘在 6 點半響起。

en: I hit the snooze button twice before getting up.
zh: 起床前我按了兩次貪睡延遲鬧鐘。

en: I make my bed as soon as I get out of it.
zh: 我一起床的第一件事就是把被子床鋪整理好。

en: Opening the window lets fresh morning air in.
zh: 把窗戶打開能讓早晨新鮮的空氣流通進來。

en: I brew a fresh pot of coffee every single morning.
zh: 我每天清晨都會親自現煮一整壺熱咖啡。

en: The kitchen smells amazing when coffee is brewing.
zh: 煮咖啡時，整個廚房都瀰漫著濃郁迷人的香氣。

en: What do you want for breakfast? Toast or oatmeal?
zh: 你早餐想吃什麼？烤土司還是燕麥粥？

en: I'll have some toast with butter and jam, please.
zh: 我要烤土司抹奶油和果醬，謝謝。

en: Eating a healthy breakfast gives you fuel for the day.
zh: 吃一頓健康的早餐能為你整天提供充足的動力。

en: I need to water the house plants on the balcony.
zh: 我得去陽台幫那些室內盆栽澆澆水了。

en: Look at that orchid, it's finally blooming!
zh: 你看那盆蘭花，它終於開花了！

en: Gardening is such a peaceful and relaxing hobby.
zh: 蒔花弄草做園藝真是一項寧靜又舒壓的嗜好。

en: I'm sorting through my closet to donate old clothes.
zh: 我正在整理衣櫃，打算把舊衣服整理出來捐贈。

en: Decluttering your room really clears your mind.
zh: 把房間斷捨離收拾乾淨，心靈真的會跟著清爽起來。

en: Put the recycling bins out on the curb tonight.
zh: 今晚記得把資源回收桶推到路邊放好。

en: Tomorrow morning is recycling pickup day.
zh: 明天早上是回收車來清運的日子。

en: I always bring reusable shopping bags to the store.
zh: 我去超市買東西時總是會自備環保購物袋。

en: Saving electricity and turning off lights helps the planet.
zh: 隨手隨處關燈節約用電有助於保護我們的地球。

en: I like spending time outdoors in nature on weekends.
zh: 我喜歡在週末假日多花點時間身處大自然戶外。

en: A walk in the forest reduces stress and anxiety.
zh: 在森林步道裡散步能有效減輕生活壓力和焦慮感。

en: I feel so grounded when I go hiking in the mountains.
zh: 去山裡健行爬山時，我感到內心無比踏實平靜。

en: Make sure to wear comfortable hiking boots.
zh: 出發前務必確認穿上舒適好走的登山鞋。

en: Pack plenty of water and energy snacks in your backpack.
zh: 在後背包裡準備充足的水和高能量小點心。

en: Safety always comes first when you're exploring outdoors.
zh: 在戶外探索大自然時，安全永遠是第一考量。

en: I twisted my ankle while jogging on the uneven trail.
zh: 在不平坦的小徑上慢跑時，我不小心扭到了腳踝。

en: Apply an ice pack to reduce the swelling.
zh: 趕快冰敷一下來幫助消腫退腫。

en: Elevate your foot on a pillow and rest it.
zh: 把腳墊在高枕頭上抬高，並且好好靜養。

en: If the pain doesn't improve by tomorrow, see a doctor.
zh: 如果到了明天疼痛沒有改善，一定要去看醫生。

en: I'm feeling much better today, the swelling went down.
zh: 我今天感覺好多了，腫脹已經明顯消退了。

en: Take it easy and don't rush back to heavy exercise.
zh: 放慢步調休養，先別急著恢復高強度的激烈運動。

en: Listen to your body and give it time to heal.
zh: 多傾聽身體發出的聲音，給自己充足的自癒時間。

en: A balanced diet and good sleep work wonders.
zh: 均衡的飲食加上優質充足的睡眠，效果非常神奇。

en: I'm cooking a warm pot of chicken noodle soup.
zh: 我正在燉煮一鍋溫熱暖胃的雞湯麵。

en: Nothing soothes a cold better than hot chicken soup.
zh: 沒有什麼比一碗熱騰騰的雞湯更能舒緩感冒的不適了。

en: Have a big bowl and get some rest in bed.
zh: 多喝一大碗，然後回床上好好躺著休息。

en: Thank you so much for taking care of me today.
zh: 今天真的太感謝你無微不至地照顧我了。

en: That's what family and friends are here for!
zh: 家人和朋友本來就是要在這時候互相照應的！

en: I'm ready to turn off the lights and fall asleep.
zh: 我準備把燈關掉，要進入夢鄉了。

en: Have a restful night and sleep tight.
zh: 祝你有個安穩香甜的夜晚，睡個好覺。

en: See you tomorrow morning, bright and early!
zh: 明天一早見，神采飛揚！

en: Good night!
zh: 晚安！

en: Sweet dreams!
zh: 祝好夢！

en: Take good care of yourself always.
zh: 平時隨時都要好好照顧愛惜自己的身體喔。
